tei:div.tei:p: rgyal ba g.yung ston dpal gyi lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /de la rje rang byung rdo rjes bstan pa gtod par dgongs pa ni/ rtogs ldan chen po grags seng ba yin kyang*/ bde chen gyi gdan sar bskos pa ma mdzad pa dang*/ yang kam̐ po gnas nang du 'byon par bkas bskul nas byon pa na/ lam du gzim dril dkar mo mtshur mda'i ri la 'dzegs pa ma zlog nas/ ri steng gi spang thang spro ba'i chu mig rtsar nyal 'dug pas/ der thugs pheb nas thog mar tsha ba mdzad/ de nas gdan phab ste/ rten 'brel gyis gnas nang du btags nas/ mtshur gnas nang kho nar bzhugs pa shar bas/ sku skye ba phyi ma dang mjal ma thub/ ༈¿¿des na zung 'jug ma'i brgyud la bzhugs pa ni/ rgyal ba g.yung yin te/ ru lag gi tshong dus mgur mo'i lho phyogs zha lu gser khang gi bya 'dab 'og tu sngags rnying ma'i nus ldan bar ma chad par byung ba'i/ g.yung gi brgyud 'dzin jo sras dbul po zhig gi sras su shing sprel la 'khrungs/ mtshan rdo rje 'bum chung ngu'i dus nas yab chos rnams la sbyangs/ yum gyis khrid nas tshong dus bon grong du/ khro phu'i mkhan chen bsod nams seng ge las/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos/ dgung lo bco lnga bzhes nas 'ug pa lung du mda' dang*/ zur dang*/ 'ba' la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams bsten/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag mang du gsan zhing*/ bskyed rdzogs la sbyangs/ der lo gsum song nas zur chos pa'ang lo gsum mdzad/ zha lu'i grwa sar mkhan slob gnyis las phar tshad bsdus gsum dang*/ zur gyi drung pa las mngon pa kun btus la mkhas par mdzad/ gzhan yang dam pa 'ga' zhig bsten cing*/ gsar rnying gi sngags pa la yon tan che bar hor yul tshun chad du grags pas/ hor rgyal pos mi chen saṃ ga ta mngags nas sku rim du spyan drangs/ pho brang shong tor gu lug gan dang mjal/ rgyal po'i lung gis zi ra 'ur rdor srid pa ma mo'i spyi mdos chen mo/ sngags pa lnga brgya tsam gyis zla ba gsum du bsags/

zla gcig tu bsgrubs nas btang bas/ cho 'phrul dang ngo mtshar mang du byung*/ bum chu rgyal bu ku sha la la drangs pas thugs shin tu mnyes/ khol na'u zhes par than pa chen po byung bar gong ma'i bkas char pa 'bebs su bcug pas/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i char chen po phab/ ti shrī sangs rgyas dpal gyis/ 'di lta bu'i sngags pa ni/ bandhe bon po zim shing sogs thams cad la mkho bas ris med du bkur zhig /ces bdag rkyen mdzad/ de'i dbyar pho brang chen po shong to dang*/ dgun ta'i tur pheb/ dpyid kar rgyal po'i phyag phyir 'ur rdor byon/ gzhan yang a lan theg ma dang*/ pho brang cang to sogs su pheb nas/ zlos gar dang*/ mig 'phrul dang/ rol mo la sogs pa'i ltad mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs pas/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs/ chos kho na la thugs gzhol yang/ rgyal pos ma gnang/ rgyal po gshegs nas bod du byon/ yum gyi bka' ma zlog par jo mo zhig bzhes pas/ lo gnyis nas sras gcig byung ma thag /'di la yum gyis sems kyi gtad so gyis shig /gsungs te/ de ma thag rab tu byung dgongs nas/ phyag rdzas thams cad ngo shes grogs po sogs su la yang ma gnang bar yum khrid de sa skya/ khro phu/ zha lu/ gsang phu sogs dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad du/ 'gyed dang/ 'bul ba mdzad/ yum rang bsngo ba zhur bcug /zha lu'i skor khang logs la sangs rgyas stong rtsa bzhengs/ de nas shing stag dbyar 'bring po'i tshes gsum la/ chos lung 'tshogs pa stag mkhar du/ dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ mkhan chen grags gzhon pa las rab tu byung zhing*/ dad dge sum cu'i dbus su chig rdzogs mdzad/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rdo rje dpal/ slar yang thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson pa bskyed pa'i go cha chen po bzhes nas/ mkhas grub kyi yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas gangs can 'dir bzhugs so 'tshal gyi dbang khrid man ngag bshad ka sogs/ 'di ma gsan pa med pa lta bur mdzad/

khyad par rje rang byung ba las gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gsan te/ thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs/ phung po ri po che/ mon spa gro sogs su sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad pas/ mchog gi grub pa brnyes/ mon spa gror byon nas thugs dam gyi rtsal chen po byung ba'i don la/ mnyam med rgyal ba g.yung ston pas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i mgur yang gsungs/ rgod sgros chu'i grod pa dum bur bcad kyang*/ chu mi 'bo ba dang*/ lcags bsregs blangs kyang mi 'tshig pa dang*/ rtsig pa la rdo drug sbyor gyi zhal ba byas pas/ rtsig pa brag chen po gcig tu 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i rten 'brel mang po yang mkhyen/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa kun la dri yig bskur ba sus kyang lan ma byung ba la lan mdzad pa dang*/ sngags kyi sangs rgyas dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi sangs rgyas gnyis kyi khyad 'byed mdzad pa gzigs pas/ shin tu dad de dpon slob bco lngas phung po ri bo cher byon te/ zhabs la gtugs/ sku tshe de nyid la gsan bsam ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul yang*/ de nyid kyi gsung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ chung dus rang gi pha las klog yig dang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dang*// gnas bsreg tshe sgrub na rag skong la sogs/ /bdag don gzhan don dbyangs dang phyag bzhes can/ /chog khrigs las kyi kha tshar tshang bar bslab/ /jo mo lcam gyi lugs kyi tshe sgrub dang*/ /phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs sgom lung thob/ /rdo rje phur ba rtsa ba sor bzhag dang*/ / man ngag drug pa dbyangs dang phyag bzhes bcas/ /gzhan yang mnga' bdag pa dang chos dbang gi /lugs kyi gu ru padma'i byin rlabs thob/ /de nas bco lnga'i lo lon dus su ni/ / mkhas grub rtsod med nyi zla ltar grags pa/ /zur chen shākya 'byung gnas zhes grags pa'i/ / gdan sa dpal ldan 'ug pa lung du phyin/ /mda' tig chos kyis shākya'i brgyud 'dzin pa/ / gsang sngags rnying ma'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog

/mda' ston shākya 'phel gyi zhabs la gtugs/ /gsang ba snying po'i rgyud la nan tan byas// bcu bdun lo la bshad gsar zur chos gnyis/ /lhan cig byas nas lo 'ga'i bar du bshad/ /slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ /dam tshig gsal bkra nyan shing gzhan la'ang bshad/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'chi med rgyud las ni/ /gsungs pa'i tshe yi sgrub pa'i sgrub dbang zhus/ /sgyu 'phrul lugs kyi zhi khro rab gnas kyi/ /phyag len sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang*/ /gzhan yang thal chen rab gnas las sgom dang*/ /bum pa la sogs yan lag rab gnas sogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas chog khrigs rnams/ /phyag len tshang ba lhag ma med par zhus/ /'gyod tshangs bshags pa na rag dong sprug dang*/ /ma mo srid pa bems kyi mdos chen dang*/ /de yi ming po srid pa pho mdos bcas/ /de yi mdos 'khor phyogs bzhi'i mdos chen brgyad/ /shar du dkar mo dbu dgu'i mdos dang ni/ /de yi ming po rgyal po rtse mdos bcas/ /lho ru smug mo dbu lnga'i mdos dang ni/ /de yi ming po gshin rje 'char ka'i mdos/ /nub tu dmar mo tsa mun ti dang ni/ /ming po btsan sil stong gi mdos su bcas/ /byang du mtsho sman rgyal mo'i gur mdos dang*/ /ming po gnod sbyin stong gi mdos dang bcas/ /de dag ma mo srid pa rgyud lung gi /yan lag ma mo'i spyi rgyud du grags pa/ /srid pa bems dang tsitta rakta dang*/ /mkha' la skar tshogs rnams las gsungs pa yi/ /ma mo'i mdos chen bsngo ba rgyas 'bring gsum/ /bsngo ba rgyas pa bshad ma thag pa yi/ /srid pa bems chen mdos 'khor bcas pa yin/ /bsngo ba 'bring po yang gab ma bzhi yin/ /bsngo ba bsdus pa srid pa'i spyi mdos yin// de yang mdos 'khor phran dang bcas rnams ni/ /srid pa g.yul zlog zla rgyas tshe yi mdos/ /dkar mo dal skyong mkhris pa laṅka yi/ /gser mdos dang ni sha khrag bems gling mdos/

/dmu chu grod pa'i rdzing mdos la sogs pa/ /ma mo byol zor dpon g.yog gsum pa dang*/ /gzhan yang ragsha srin po'i dgra mdos dang*/ /srin mo'i khram mdos lam sel bdud kyi mdos/ /la sogs mdos phran du ma gsungs pa yang*/ /snang srid lha 'dre las la 'dzud thabs yin/ /mda' ston shākya 'phel gyi gsung las thos/ /gzhan yang lha 'dre stong 'dre'i rgyud las ni/ /gsungs pa'i mdos phran pho mdos mo mdos rnams/ /stong phrag gnyis po rnams kyang lag len dang*/ /bcas pa zhus shing 'ga' re'i lag len byas/ / gzhi thog 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan las/ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed cho ga thos/ /slob dpon snyan ston shākya seng ge las/ /gsang ba snying po'i khog dbub mang du nyan/ /zhi khro gnas lung cha gsum dpal sdom ma/ /rnams kyi sgom bkod rnams dang za tshogs dang*/ /rgyun bshags rta 'phreng rdo rje las rim dang*/ /skye bo gso thig rnams kyi bklags lung zhus/ /bla ma dgyer ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan la/ /thugs thig rta rim dbang gi gal po yi/ /rtsa ba 'grel par bcas pa rnams kyang thob/ /sgyu 'phrul bla ma'i sgrub thabs rgyud kyi don/ /gsal byed la shan lta ba'i sgron me dang*/ /khro bo'i rtogs pa lha rgyud bka' lung dang*/ /padmas mdzad pa'i dpe chung rang gnas thob/ /rim drug yang dag rtsa ba mdo byang bcas/ /gzhan yang zhi khro las kyi gal phreng dang*/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i sems bskyed rtsa ba dang*/ /khro bo phyag rgya gcig pa zhal gsum dang*/ /phyag drug pa dang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /de bzhin zhi ba phyag rgya bzhi pa dang*/ /dbang gi man ngag gsang thig thugs thig dang*/ /rna rgyud gsang thig dbang gi 'grel pa bcas/ gzhan yang gzhal yas mun sel sgron ma dang*/ /sbyin sreg spyi don bcu gcig pa rnams thos/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa dang*/ /sems lung chen mo khu phyug rol pa'i mdo/

/he ru ka yi gal po che chung dang*/ /'jig rten 'das mdo che chung rngam glog dang*/ /kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo la sogs pa yi/ /lung gi mdo bdun rnams kyang bdag gis thos/ /gsang ba snying po'i 'grel pa spar khab dang*/ /theg chen rnal 'byor zhen log spong sgron dang*/ /dad pa bskyed sgron lta ba gsal sgron sogs/ /rgyud dang man ngag phra mo ji rigs thob// gzhan yang rta mgrin bde gshegs 'dus pa yi/ /byin rlabs bka' dang de yi chos skor la/ /lo rgyus brtsams tshul sgrub thabs rtsa ba dang*/ /thems kyi man ngag rnam pa gsum te lnga/ /las byang sgom khog mngon rtogs bcas pas bdun/ /phur pas bsregs dang sbyin sregs mnan dang bcu/ /srung zlog nad pa sri'u gso ba dang*/ /rta mgrin srung ba sgo bzhis bcu bzhi tshang*/ /las byang che chung gnyis dang dbang ka dang*/ /rgyun gtor nar ma gtor chog chung ngu dang*/ /rtsa ba gcig la nang tshegs sum cu lnga/ /de ltar dbang dang gdams skor bcas pa zhus// grub chen u rgyan pa ru graḍa pa las/ /bsnyen gnas lan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga thob/ / thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ /rtsā mchog rtag tu ngu yi bcud len zhus/ /bla ma rta ston gzi brjid chen po la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo/ /mang du nyan nas nan tan cher byas shing*/ /mkhas par sbyangs nas gzhan la'ang tshar 'ga' bshad/ / gzhan yang sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i dbang ka dang*/ /rgyud kyi bshad bka' man ngag ci rigs thos/ /de gzhan a ro ye shes 'byung gnas las/ /gnyag chen ku mā ra nas brgyud pa yi/ / rin chen 'phags lam bkod pa'i rgyud dang ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo gsang ba snying rgyud dang*/ /rdzogs pa chen po nyi ma snying po'i rgyud/ /ye shes gsang ba sgron ma'i rgyud dang bzhi/ / de dag rnams kyi dgongs don a ro yi/ /man ngag be bum che chung gnyis su bsdebs/ /de gzhan a ro'i theg chen rnal 'byor dang*/

/zhen log spong sgron dad skyed sgron me dang*/ /man ngag cog bzhag la soḍa gdams phran rnams/ /sems sde ma bu bco brgyad a ro lugs/ / 'di rnams a ro'i chos skor yin par graḍa/ /sgyu 'phrul 'ong rim dam tshig phra rgyas dang*/ / phyag rgya bsam gtan za tshogs rgyun bshags sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul phra mo rnams kyang mang du thos/ /rten 'brel snying po mdo dang rtsa ba dang*/ /rten 'brel rab gnas las byang chog khrid bcas/ /lhag ma med par yongs su rdzogs par thob/ /dgongs 'dus 'grel pa bdun pa'i go cha dang*/ /mdo bcu grangs mthun rin chen 'phrul yig sogs/ /lung gi man ngag rnams kyang ci rigs thob/ /'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang ni zur chung gi/ /zhal gyi gdams pa brgyad cu pa yang thos// yang khol chos skor rnams dang ma mo ni/ /dpon g.yog gsum pa rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs thos/ /tshar gsum khug pa ting 'dzin dbang bzhi dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang*/ /nā ro chos drug nyams khrid rdzogs par zhus/ /slob dpon padma'i sgrub thabs mnga' bdag lugs/ /phyi sgrub che chung gnyis dang nang sgrub ni/ /che 'bring chung gsum gsang ba'i sgrub pa dang*/ /zhi byed rnam gsum rtags yig dmar khrid gsum/ /dbang dang byin rlabs re re'ang lu gu rgyud/ /che chung rnams kyang rdzogs par bdag gis zhus/ /gzhan yang gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug lugs/ /padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgrub thabs zhus/ /bla ma lce zhig chen po shes 'bum la/ /slob dpon a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyi/ /man ngag gdab spungs gnyis kyi dmar khrid dang*/ /kun byed rgyal po'i lung dang mdzub khrid zhus/ /snyan brgyud drug skor phyag cha drug skor dang*/ /snyan brgyud thugs kyi snying po rnams kyang zhus/ /de sras slob dpon chos skyong 'bum la yang*/ /dka' thub rde'u 'cha' zhus nas nyams su blangs/ /skye dman mkhas grub zur mo sras btsun la/

/kun byed rgyal po ma bu skor dgu dang*/ /snyan brgyud rin chen spungs pa'i khrid lung zhus/ /sems sde ma bu bco brgyad dbang gi bka'/ /re re'ang bdag rtag man ngag la sogs pa/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang bco brgyad re re'ang*/ /gdams skor bcas pa sum brgya nyi shu bzhi/ /rdzogs pa chen po sgra bo nag po'i skor/ /thams cad ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par zhus// kun byed thos bsam sgom gsum rgyud gsum dang*/ /de dag nang nas rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi yang*/ /yang snying nam mkha' che yi bshad pa'i rgyud/ /mdo bcu dang ni shes bya mtha' gcod rnams/ /ma lngar grags shing de bzhin bu bzhi ru/ /grags pa zab mo dri ma med pa yi/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras ston pa'i rgyud sde bzhi/ /kun byed ma bu dgu skor du graḍa pa/ /khyad par 'khor ba rtsad gcod rgyud sde bzhi/ /dbang dang ngo sprod gdams skor lnga bcu brgyad/ /de dag kun kyang bdag gis ma lus zhus// gzhan yang rgya gar mkhas pa bdun brgyud dang*/ /de bzhin rgya nag mkhas pa bdun brgyud kyi/ /gdams ngag a ro'i khyad chos rnams dang ni/ /de gzhan dgongs don gsal ba'i sgron me dang*/ /sgro skur mun sel la sogs gdams phran ni/ /lo rgyus chen mo khog dbub rgyas bsdus dang*/ /cog ro zangs dkar la gdams ka tshom dang*/ /byang chub sems 'grel rin chen lde mig dang*/ /sgo gsum gtan la 'bebs pa'i lde mig dang*/ /zhus len gal chen gnad kyi lde mig dang*/ /gces ston 'phrul gyi lde mig bzhi skor dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam ma bu yi/ /ngo sprod gdams skor bcas pa ma lus zhus/ /a ro'i gyad khams 'phrul gyi lde mig dang*/ /sgo yod gzer mig drug pa'i man ngag dang*/ /sems kyi mun sel sgron ma rnams kyang zhus//

gzhan yang a ro phyi skor cha lag ni/ /theg pa chen po rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /man ngag rnams dang gzhan yang gsang skor gyi/ /'phrul gyi lde mig 'phrul 'khor lde mig dang*/ /'dra ba'i man ngag gzer kha che chung dang*/ /mdo bzhi'i gdams pa sang tshul nyi ma'i sgron/ / gdams pa'i khrid yig skor gsum bskor lugs sogs/ /gal 'gegs gser gyi lde mig rnams dang ni/ /'phrul gyi lde mig bzhi skor 'jug sgo sogs/ /gdams phran ma lus bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po'i rig gtad dang*/ /gzungs dang gzungs chog 'dres pa sgrub thabs sogs/ /slob dpon sha ba ri nas brgyud pa'ang thob/ /'gro mgon zhang gi rnam thar bka' rgya ma/ /bzang yul mon pa gdong dmar graḍa pa yi/ /rdo rje rba rlab dbang dang ngo sprod bcas/ /zab lam gdams skor bcas pa ma lus thob/ /phag mo khros ma nag mo'i byin rlabs bka'/ /sgrub thabs las tshogs kun gyi dbang yang zhus// gzhan yang skye med rig ma las brgyud pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa dang*/ /dam pa dmar po'i a yi zab rgya'ang zhus/ /thams cad mkhyen pa zur gyi gdung 'dzin pa/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas mtshan can de la yang*/ /gsang ba snying po dgongs pa 'dus pa dang*/ / man ngag lam rim rnams ni mang du nyan/ /mngon pa gong ma kun las btus dang ni/ /smra sgo mtshon cha rnams kyang shes par bslabs/ /dgongs 'dus 'grel pa lung bstan ma yang thob// gzhan yang bklags lung thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ /rin chen 'phrul mig sbyin bsreg bsdus pa dang*/ /na rag dong sprug rtsa ba las byang dang*/ /yi ge brgya pa'i bshags sgrub 'don thabs dang*/ /bum khrus la sogs ma lus bdag gis zhus/ /srid gcig rdo rje rme ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ /las tshogs bcas pa ma lus bdag gis zhus/ /mkha' 'gro rig byed rtsal gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ /de bzhin mig dmar gza' yi sgrub thabs dang*/

/skye ba brtag dang dri za sgra sgrogs dang*/ /phra men ngag 'grol la sogs phran tshegs kyi/ /man ngag sna tshogs rnams kyang bdag gis zhus/ /gsang sngags zab lam seng ge mjing bsnol gyi/ / dbang dang byin rlabs khrid skor bcas pa rnams/ /dmar po zhal slob rgya nag gcer bu yi/ /phyag len bzhin du nyams khrid rdzogs par zhus// gzhan yang gtum mo'i mthar thug srub shing ma/ /ras rkyang ma thub bar du legs par bskyangs/ /a ma lab kyi sgron ma'i gcod yul skor/ /bka' brgyud nyams brgyud sga bsgril gsum dang ni/ /mal gcod 'khrul gcod la sogs mang na yang*/ /khyad par nyams brgyud phyi nang gsang ba don/ /ka tshom ngo sprod gnad them la zla bzhi'i/ /chos skor ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par zhus/ /grub thob ku ku ri pa las brgyud pa'i/ /'pho ba khyad 'phags bde chen mkha' spyod ma/ /zhus nas tshad la ma pheb bar du bsgom/ / gzhan yang theg pa'i yang rtse a ti yi/ /shan 'byed la zla rang grol man ngag rgyud/ / gnas lugs 'khrul tshul rtogs thabs goms thabs dang*/ /mthar thug 'bras bu rtsod ston rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /yan lag rgyud sde nyi shu rtsa lngar bcas/ /de dag don 'grel yang sprul rig 'dzin rnams/ /rgya bod gang zag grub pa brnyes rnams kyis/ /gnyer yig rim pa bzhin du brtsams rnams dang*/ /chos sgo 'byed pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dbang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba don gyi ngo sprod rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis thob pa yin/ / gzhan yang 'jam dpal smra seng rjes gnang gi/ /sgrub thabs las tshogs rnams dang bcas pa dang*/ /de bzhin dbyangs can ma yi rjes gnang yang*/ /sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa ma lus zhus/ /phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po yi/ /dbang bskur slob dpon chen po a gro la/ /rgya nag yul du thob kyang rtsa bshad rgyud/ /'grel byas gdams skor rgya chos bco brgyad po/ /bod yul sleb dus thams cad mkhyen pa zur/

/bka' drin can gyi bla ma de la zhus/ /bla ma zhang ston yon tan mgon po la/ /phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs rigs gtad dang*/ /gzungs dang sgrub skor rnams kyang ci rigs zhus/ /gsang rdzogs lugs ky-i sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi/ /dbang bka' lus kyi dkyil 'khor lugs kyang thob/ /bsam gtan nyams sgron rin chen snying sgron dang*/ /bar do bdud rtsi sgron ma rnams kyang thob/ /gzhan yang bar do bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang*/ /maṇḍal phyi nang gsang ba don gyi khrid/ /ma lus rdzogs par zhus nas nyams su blangs/ /de gzhan dzam lha nag po'i rjes gnang dang*/ /de yi chos skor dngos grub khros chen rgyud/ /mngon rtoḍa gnad yig srog 'khor bcas chog soḍa// las tshogs kha tshang ma lus bdag gis zhus// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tshad du phyin pa yi/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /she'u ston shākya 'phel gyi zhabs la gtugs/ /'jam dpal gshin rje kha thun 'bring po dang*/ /de bzhin tshe bdag nag po'i dbang zhus nas/ /gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams kyi lung*/ /thob pa rnams kyang dkar chag btab pa ni/ /'jam dpal sdig pa stobs chen chos skor la/ /khro bo snying gzir gsang ba'i rgyud skor dang*/ /rtsa ba drag sngags srung ba rno ba'i dpal/ /mtshon cha'i yi ge 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ /bsdebs pa rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /gzhan yang bdud rtsi 'od kyi sgron ma dang*/ /bsam gtan bum pa'i kha che'i rgyal po dang*/ /gha ru ṇa yi nam mkha' lding gi rgyud/ /bya khyung sgrub thabs drag por sgrub pa dang*/ /nam mkha' lding gi man ngag zor gyi las/ /pra khog snang zhes bya ba'i rtogs pa dang*/ /pra khog snang gi gnan pa'i gdams yig dang*/ /klu rnams stobs kyis mnan pa'i man ngag dang*/ /sbyin sreg rim gsum bram ze ku su lu/ /dngos grub brnyes nas mdzad pa rnams dang ni/ /sdig pa stobs chen gsang ba'i rgyud chen dang*/

/de yi man ngag brtag pa dgu pa dang*/ /gsal ba'i sgron me gsal ba'i nyi ma dang*/ /gdug pa klu la rang gshed dbab pa dang*/ /sdig pa snying la ru 'dzings nag po'i bcud/ /srung ba'i mthar thug drag po'i 'khor lo yi/ /sbyor kha gnyis pa la sogs thams cad kun/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis thob pa yin/ / gzhan yang sman dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dang*/ /rtsub bshal pra khrid bum pa skor rtse'i bshal/ /bdud rtsi bzang drug man ngag e ran ta'i/ /pra khrid log gnon yig chung rnams dang ni/ /kha spu'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dang*/ /kha spu'i lag len bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dang*/ /dmar len srog gi srung ba khyad par can/ /drag sngags logs su bkol ba rnams kyang thob/ /rus sbal khra bo'i man ngag tu bkod pa/ /bdud rtsi dum bu zhes bya chu ser gyi/ /nad gso'i rim pa le'u nyi shu gnyis/ /drang srong ye shes grags kyis bsdebs pa thos/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal sdig pa stobs chen gyi/ /rgyud kyi gcod skor srung ba bcud dril ba/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya'i man ngag dang*/ /drag sngags rgyal po yang gsang bcu gcig pa'i/ /man ngag bsad pa srog gi 'khor lo dang*/ /drag po sngags kyi de nyid bstan pa dang*/ /dmar len sbyin sreg bsad pa'i man ngag dang*/ /rgya than kyin thang dbab pa'i man ngag dang*/ /bzlas pa sngags kyi gnad yig rnams kyang thob// gzhan yang sdig pa snying 'dzings chos skor la/ /sdig pa nag po snying 'dzings gsang ba'i rgyud/ /de yi chos skor rnams kyi kha byang dang*/ /phyi gcod 'phrul gyi lde mig de las gzhan/ /sgron ma gsal ba'i pra khrid la sogs pa/ /phyi sgrub mchod rten dag la brten pa'i thabs/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi 'bru bshad them yig ni/ /drag po sngags kyi 'bru 'grel bcas pa dang*/ /sngags don gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma dang*/ /sgom rim man ngag 'khor lo'i pra khrid dang*/

/de bzhin 'jam dpal dril sgrub bsad pa dang*/ /zil gnon sgrub khog chen po'i rtsa ba dang*/ /'jam dpal gshin rje sgron ma pra khrid dang*/ /mchod rten lag tu blangs pa'i pra khrid ni/ /gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i man ngag dang*/ /dbang gi cho ga mu tig phreng ba dang*/ /gzhan yang mchod bstod gsal ba'i sgron me dang*/ /tshe bdag nag po mchod pa'i las rim dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po gsal ba'i sgron ma dang*/ /gsang ba sbas tig rnams ni snying 'dzings skor/ /gzhan yang gnam lcags ur mo'i skor la ni/ /stong srog 'khor lo bzhi ru grags pa yi/ /rdo rje ur mo rtog pa bco brgyad rgyud/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ /gzhan yang phyir zlog 'khor lo phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo lnga yi sgron ma lag len bcas/ /phyir zlog sngags kyi lag len rnams dang ni/ /nyi zla kha sbyor byung na gsal mdangs dbyung*// seng ge kha 'thab byung na rtsal chen ston/ /sgyogs gnyis nam mkhar 'thab na sgyogs rdo bcag /de sogs rno gsum mtshon du bzung ba dang*/ /don po dong du bsad pa'i man ngag dang*/ /gzhan yang stong srog 'khor lo drag po dang*/ /gnam lcags ur mo gsang ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ /bsad pa'i man ngag mā ra ya yi las/ /brnag pa'i las byang gnad gcod snying le rnams/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pas brgyan pa thob/ /gshed po'i sbyor ba bcas pas 'grub pa dang*/ /kā la yagsha rdo rje'i sbyor ba dang*/ /bdud srin nag mo 'chi ltas can gyi sngags/ /de dag rnams ni bcas chog gsum yin gsungs// ur mo sbog chog sngags kyi phra men ni/ /gtsug lag dpal dge'i cog brdung yin no gsungs/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed nag po/ /a mu ka phung gi ni rgyud chen dang*/ /tshe bdag me rlung skyan thang khros pa'i rgyud/ /nyi ma mig dmar le'u nga gsum pa/ / gza' mchog rā hu la yi skye rgyud ni/

/'jig rten skrag byed tre log skad 'byin rgyud// gzhan yang dmar len srog gi rgyud skor la/ /dmar len spu gri le'u bcu bzhi pa/ / drag po sngags rgod dmar len yang gsang gi /spu gri rgyud chen le'u bdun pa dang*/ /zla gsang nag po srin mo khrag 'thung gi /'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs bcas pa dang*/ / drag sngags kun gyi thus ka phra men gyi/ /sdebs kyi drag sngags smre tri kha sbyor dang*/ /tshe bdag mgo dgu pa yi drag sngags dang*/ /bye ba dgu khri sa ya gtum po yi/ /drag sngags mthar thug srog bdag bshan pa ni/ /dmar po bsad pa spu gri nag po dang*/ /klu yi bshan pa tshe bdag nag po yi/ /ngan pa rang gshed bshan pa dmar len dang*/ /yang gsang drag sngags mthar thug rnams kyang thob// gzhan yang gnam lcags 'bab pa'i ngan sngags dang*/ /ser ba glo bur dbab pa'i man ngag dang*/ /gzhan yang gnod sbyin srog zan man ngag sogs/ /'jig rten phung byed bzlog mo snying 'khor dang*/ /drag sngags zla gsang nag po gsang ba yi/ /srog zan kun gyi yang snying mthar thug dang*/ /klu bdud nag po srog gi 'khor lo dang*/ /drag sngags mtshon cha bsnol ma rang gcod dang*/ /zla gsang mchod rten nag po drag sngags dang*/ /mtshon cha dmag gi sgro nag la sogs pa/ /phra men nag mo'i drag sngags sdebs pa dang*/ /las kyi mtha' brtul bye ba dgu khri'i las/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gsang nag po yi/ /drag sngags rang gshed sta mo kha 'thab dang*/ /rang gshed seng ge kha 'thab me nag gi /sgron ma la sogs gdams skor ma lus thob// klu yi rgyal po nag po mgo dgu pa/ /zhes bya sgrub pa'i thabs dang khyad par gyi/ /drag sngags mda' 'dra lnga ru grags pa ni/ /srung ba gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ /de gzhan mtshon cha las kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /ga'u dkar po srog gi dra ba dang*/ /ging chen tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ /sgrub pa'i thabs dang srog bdag sems dpa' ni/

/ dkar po gsang ba gnad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gzhan yang srog bdag spun gsum drag sngags dang*/ /shel ging nag po bdud kyi man ngag ni/ /mthar thug bsad pa las kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /srog bdag gser gyi nyi ma las byung ba'i/ /man ngag mthar thug zhal gdams rnams dang bcas/ /srog bdag dkar po snying 'byin drag sngags sogs/ /srog bdag sgrub lugs mi 'dra bdun dang ni/ /btsan rgod srog gzer ga'u dmar po yi/ /snying sgrub dang ni nag po mig gcig pa/ /bdud kyi drag sngags cog brdung mthar thug dang*/ / tsan ti dmar po khyad par ser pa yi/ /rtsog brdung mda' 'dra rnams kyang bdag gis bslab/ /'jam dpal gshin rje kha thun 'bring po yi/ /dbang ka gdams skor bcas pa thob pa ni/ /mdo byang rtsa ba 'grel par bcas pa dang*/ /phrin las las byang rtog med spros bral dang*/ /dus gsum mngon gyur drag po las khrog sogs/ /gdams skor rnams kyang bdag gis shes zhing bsgrubs// las thig gsang ba sum cu pa yi rgyud/ /de yi smad las 'khrul 'khor gter ma'i skor// 'khrul 'khor rtsa ba 'jam dpal gshin rje dang*/ /'khrul 'khor man ngag khang bu bcu drug pa/ /gzhan yang gshed bzhi las kyi lde mig soḍa/ /'khrul 'khor nag po yang snying gsang ba yi/ /man ngag shin tu zab pa bcu drug dang*/ /'khor lo gsang ba'i pra khrid zhes bya ba/ / las kyi gshin rje nag po'i las byang dang*/ /sgrol ging nag po bdud kyi mde'u thung dang*/ / gza' rgod 'chi bdag gi ni mde'u thung dang*/ /de bzhin srog bdag nag po'i mde'u thung dang*/ /mtha' bsdus las kyi sa bdag mde'u thung dang*/ /klu yi mdze zer nag po la sogs pa/ /sgrol ging drug gi bsad thabs phyir zlog gi /man ngag dang ni mtshon cha lde mig dang*/ /'khor lo 'gros thabs brgyad kyi man ngag dang*/ /de bzhin 'khor lo mun sel nyi ma dang*/ /phyi rgyud las kyi phran bu rnams dang ni/

/rdo rje nang 'gras rang gshed 'khor lo dang*/ /de bzhin gsang ba ro langs 'khor lo dang*/ /gzhan yang 'byung ba bshig pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ /gsang ba'i man ngag zor kha thun drug las/ /rgyud las byung ste man ngag tu bkod pa// nyi ma bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs rtsa 'grel dang*/ /spyi yi man ngag rtags kyi yi ge dang*/ /bla dang lha 'dre rgyu ba'i dus bstan pa/ /gzhan yang 'khyams ldog gnad kyi man ngag dang*/ /gtad gnyer bcu gnyis dang ni 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /mtsho bsdeb lag len bcas pa bdag gis shes/ /lag tu blangs pa'i pra khrid dā na rdas/ /gter bzhad rtsal la gtad pa'i lag len lnga/ /sngags kyi grangs tshad dang ni bgrang lugs dang*/ /de yi dgongs pa dang ni dgug dbye dang*/ /gzir mnan bya ba rnams kyang bdag gis shes/ /gzhan yang kha thun man ngag dang po la/ /bsten nas sgrub pa bye ma reg gcod kyi/ /rtsa ba las byang gdams pa zhal khrid sogs/ /sgron ma dpe byang lag len bcas pa shes// de las gzhan yang drag sngags rgyas sdebs skor/ /drag po sngaḍa rgod rgyud kyi rgyal po dang*/ /rgyas sdebs rgyud kyi rgyal po bka' 'grel dang*/ /sku gsum yongs rdzogs phrin las gsang ba'i sgron/ /gsod byed rngam pa'i las byed rnams kyang shes/ /de bzhin lha yi sgom thabs bsnyen pa'i lung*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsnyen pa'i rgyas bsdeb dang*/ /srid gsum 'dus ba'i drag sngags gtor mar bcas/ /thugs kyi thig bsdeb rigs gsum khro bo'i bsdeb/ /lto dkrugs gnad bsdeb spu gri drug skor bsdeb/ /sngags kyi don bsdeb bsdeb yig rin chen phreng*/ /gshin rje nag po 'khrul 'khor bsdeb kyi rgyud/ /phyir bzlog sngangs bsdeb rgyud kyi rgyal po dang*/ /kun dga' bo dang shā ri'i bu yi bsdebs/ /de la sogs pa'i gdams skor ma lus thob//

gzhan yang rgya mtsho dug ri ka yi skor/ /rtsa rgyud 'khor nag le'u bzhi bcu gsum/ / 'khor lo nag po rtogs pa bdun pa dang*/ /klu nag mgo dgu'i man ngag nang tshan bcas/ / rgyud kyi rgyal po rgya mtsho dug ri ka'i/ /spyi gcod bsdus don shu bo ragsha'i/ /sgrub thabs gzhan yang sbal nag 'khor lo sogs/ /lag len zhal gdams bcas pa bdag gis thob// klu rgyud 'bum gyi ti ka zhes kyang bya/ /klu yi 'khor lo nag po zhes kyang bya/ /phrin las sna tshogs bstan pa'i rgyud chen po/ /le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang ni/ /'bum tig rgyud kyi le'u bsdeb pra khrid bcas/ /rgya mtsho dug ri rtog pa dgu pa dang*/ /gtad khram kun gyi mthar thug nag po klu'i/ /dug mda' ngo ma khram 'debs zhes bya'i rgyud/ /sum cu so bzhi pa yi skabs can dang*/ /de bzhin byol song glang mgo can gyi rgyud/ /skabs bdun pa yang lag len zhal khrid bcas/ /srung ba'i yig chung gud du bkol ba dang*/ /nā ga ragsha srin po ltar sgrub thabs/ /dug ri'i ngan sngags phyir zlog 'khor lo dang*/ /ser ba dbab pa'i man ngag lag len dang*/ /mu stegs gtad dang sgrub gtad drag gtad dang*/ /'chi bdag nag po'i nor sgrub bcas pa thob// gzhan yang khang bu brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /klu mo nag mo srog rgyud pra khrid bcas/ / drag po rang gnad gsang ba'i rgyud chen gsum/ /stong gi rgyud gsum gzhan yang rgyud phran bzhi/ /de dag rtsa ba 'khor lo nag po'i rgyud/ /rgya mtsho dug ri ka yi rgyud gsum dang*/ /jo ma khram 'debs byol song glang mgo can/ /dug ri rtog pa stong gi rgyud gsum yin/ /sdig pa phung shig yang snying nag po dang*/ /sbal nag 'khor lo sa bdag srog 'khor gyi/ /rgyud rnams rgyud phran bzhi ru grags pa yin// rgyud sde de dag rnams kyi sgrub thabs ni/ /rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs la yang drug yod de/ / mdze nag las 'khor sdig pa phung shig dang*/

/sbal nag lto sbyor klu bdud sbrul nag dang*/ / sa bdag klu gnyan srog gi 'khor lo dang*/ /mdze zor nag po rnams ni yan lag rgyud/ / sgrub thabs nor sgrub rang gshed phyir zlog srung*/ /nad gso grogs dang skrad cing dgra skal du/ /gtad pa rnams ni khyad par can yin gsungs/ /'jam dpal las tig gsang ba sum bcu pa/ /gsang ba drug cu pa dang bcu dgu pa/ /de bzhin 'jam dpal gsang rgyud snga phyi gnyis/ /gzhan yang 'khrul 'khor nag po sngags rgyud dang*/ /zla gsang zor ba dmar nag rgyud dang ni/ /pra khog snang ba'i rgyud dang gzhan yang ni/ /ya ma rā dza sku khros rgyud kyang thos/ /byang bu dgu skor thugs gzer 'bru gcig pa/ /'char kha nag po ma bu zhe drug ma/ / lha mo re ma ti ni mched bzhi'i rgyud/ gzhan yang lha mo de nyid sku gcig ma/ /sgrub skor bcas pa bdag gis thob pa yin/ /nag po skra 'then shrī ral pa can/ /de la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs 'ga' yang thos/ /rdzas bzlog pho rgyud srog tig nag po dang*/ /mo rgyud pa la pa tri'i mchod rten rgyud/ /bya khyung rgyud dang klu rgyud dam tshig rgyud/ /sgrub yig man ngag che phra bco brgyad dang*/ /pra khrid man ngag che chung shog dril bcas/ /de gzhan yang sdeb gsum dang don sdeb gsum/ /'khor lo rab 'bring thams cad tshang bar thos/ / rdo rje legs pa gser kyang nag po dang*/ /dug mda' nag po glo rdeg byang bu ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig pa yang thob pa yin/ /gshin rje dmar po spu gri reg gcod dang*/ /mā ra khrag skyugs 'jig rten rlung dmar rnams/ /rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag lag len bcas/ /ru mtshon dang ni drag sngags gdug rtsub ni/ /skyin thang me rlung 'khrugs pa snga phyi gnyis/ /man ngag u rgyan padmas mdzad pa yi/ /rin chen gser gyi 'bru thus bcas pa dang*/ /bsdus don so bzhi pa dang gnad yig dang*/ /chu 'khyags glo bur dbab pa'i las dang ni/

/gza' rgod bsad pa'i cog rdung lag len bcas/ /'jig rten khams su thog ser dbab la sogs/ / gza' yi 'khrul 'khor lnga yang rdzogs par thob// gzhan yang mtshon bya las kyi 'khor lo'i las/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu cham la dbab pa'i phyir/ /gsod byed khram la btab pa'i man ngag dang*/ /de bzhin myos pa klu la gtad pa dang*/ /khrag skyug ma mo'i zor kha dbab pa dang*/ /'thoms pa bdud kyis bsad pa'i las dang ni/ /btsan rgod dngos su gzir ba gzer gyi las/ /de bzhin rgyal pos mngon sum smyo ba dang*/ /gzhan yang mu stegs mngon du bkol ba dang*/ /gza' spyang lo ma rbad pa'i lag len dang*/ /sngags pa rang gshed rang la dbab pa dang*/ /mon pa mgo dgu mngon du bkol ba dang*/ /sdig pa mgo dgus dngos su bsad pa dang*/ /sbrul nag mgo dgus klu la gtad pa dang*/ /'gro ba bsad dang lo 'bras gzhom pa dang*/ /yul mkhar phung bar byed pa la sogs pa'i/ /drag sngags gsang ba sgron ma'i skor rnams dang*/ /mu stegs pa ru las bdun thams cad thos/ /'jam dpal nag po rtsa ba'i rgyud dang ni/ /zla gsang nag po'i rgyud dang gsal byed sgron/ /'jam dpal zla seng me lce 'phreng ba'i rgyud/ /de yi phyi ma'i rgyud dang bcas pa thos// 'jam dpal nag po ro langs sha ra'i rgyud/ /nag po rnam rgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud/ /'jam dpal las bzhi 'khor lo gsang rgyud dang*/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud/ /dri ma med pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa thob/ /las kyi sbyor kha brgya rtsa gcig pa'i rgyud/ /nag po dgra sgyur kha thun nag po'i rgyud/ /nag po 'khor lo'i rgyud dang kha thun nag po'i rgyud/ /gtsug na me 'bar rgyud dang mthar thug 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /rag sha dmar nag rgyud dang rag sha glang mgo'i rgyud/ /sgyu mchog 'khor lo'i rgyud dang drag po zangs kha'i rgyud/ /drag po 'khor lo'i rgyud rnams ma lus thob/ /gzhan yang gshin rje dmar po'i rgyud sde la/

/gshin rje dmar po rtsa ba'i rgyud dang ni/ /gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud dang de'i phyi ma/ /gzhan yang ma ru ce yi rgyud dang ni/ /thor ba dmar nag rgyud dang de bzhin du/ /ga 'u dmar nag rgyud kyang thos pa yin/ /de gzhan dmar po snying zan rgyud dang ni/ /kha tham dmar nag rgyud rnams 'grel bcas thob/ /'jam dpal kha thun nag po'i dbang ka dang*/ / gdams skor rnams dang 'khrul 'khor lag len bcas/ /kha thun snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur rnams kyang thos/ /'bro lo nas brgyud rlung 'khor nag po dang*/ /dkar po bram ze sdom bzang ma yang zhus/ /gzhan yang slob dpon gyang khang shāka 'bum la/ /geg mo me chen haṃ dang rlung 'khor zhus/ /'di rnams rab tu ma byung bar du yang*/ /cung zad thos bsam byas pa'i rnam thar yin// de rjes nyi shu rtsa brgyad lo la ni/ /bsnyen par rdzogs nas las kyi slob dpon la/ / spyod 'jug dang ni sdom tshig rgyas par thos/ /mkhan chen pa las 'dul tshad mngon gsum thos/ /gsang sde'i slob dpon bkra shis dpal la yang*/ /sman lha'i mdo chog sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs dang*/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs rnams kyang zhus// phyi dus las kyi slob dpon bsod nams grags/ /mkhan po'i gdan sar tshogs pa skyong dus su/ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed cho ga dang*/ /dbu ma chen po'i khrid kyi lung rnams zhus/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang ni rnam sras kyi/ /rjes gnang dang ni don yod zhags pa yi/ /gzungs kyi sgrub pa'i chos skor rnams dang bcas/ /gzhan yang yum sgrub la sogs gdams phran 'ga'/ /blo sbyong dang ni skyes bu gsum gyi khrid/ /zhus shing tshogs pa'i slob dpon bsod bzang la/ /jo mo nang pa nas brgyud rgyud snying gi/ /'grel bcas gong ma'i dbang gi cho ga dang*/ /sbyor drug khrid yig gsal sgron rnams dang ni/ /ye shes spyan sgrub nyi zla sgrub la sogs/ /gdams skor rnams kyang bdag gis ma lus zhus/

/gzhan yang thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang*/ /skyes bu gsum gyi khrid lung rnams kyang zhus// klu gu ri pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan las/ /do ha skor gsum bdud rtsi 'byung rgyud dang*/ /cong zhi dang ni rtsā mchog rtag tu ngu*/ /nā ga ge sar bcud len rnams kyang zhus/ / slob dpon ston pa kun dga' rin chen la/ /g.yul rgyal zhes grags dbyangs 'char rgyud kyi skor/ /rtsis phran rnams dang bcas pa mkhas par bslab/ /bsam sdings bla ma mkhas grub chos rje yi/ /zhabs la gtugs nas dbang dang gdams ngag ni/ /cung zad zhus pa'i dkar chag 'di ltar yin/ /rgyud sde lnga yi byin rlabs bka' dang ni/ /phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma yi khrid/ /bde mchog lha lnga'i bka' dang de las gzhan/ /lam 'bras rgyas pa'i byin rlabs bka' rnams dang*/ /khrid bka' gdams skor bla ma dmar gyi lugs/ /lam skor brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad zhus/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi/ /khrid dang gzhan yang bde mchog lhan skyes kyi/ /dbang bka' gdams par bcas pa rnams kyang thob/ / gzhan yang 'phral gyi chos spyod bya rgyu la/ /gtor 'bum dang ni brgya rtsa su rū pa/ /klu gtor ba su ki la sogs pa thob/ /gzhan yang a ma lab sgron gcod kyi skor/ /bka' brgyud nyams brgyud sgang sgril gsum ka yi/ /nam mkha' sgo 'byed ngo sprod gdams skor sogs/ thams cad lag len bcas pa mthong zhing thos/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro nang rig 'khrul gcod dang*/ /mal gcod gdan thog gcig ma rnams kyang thob/ /mkhas grub chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa yi/ /sdom gsum nyi ma'i snying po rtsa 'grel sogs/ /gzhan yang zhal gyi gdams pa ci rigs thos// gdan sa zhang ston thugs kyi sras mchog la/ /gegs sel gzer lnga byin rlabs gdams skor dang*/ /gnad lngar bcas pa thams cad bdag gis thos/ /phyag drug mgon po'i rjes gnang chos skor gyi/ /sha ba ri pas mdzad pa la sogs dang*/

/byin rlabs yig chung zhal bzhes bcas pa thob/ /gzhan yang ri gong pa las brgyud pa yi/ /rta mgrin byin rlabs las tshogs gdam skor bcas/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis zhus pa yin// gzhan yang grub thob mgon po ye shes la/ /rdo rje rba rlabs dbang gi ngo sprod zhus/ / drin can bla ma dngul ston glang khal ba/ /khong la rdzogs chen ye shes gsang rdzogs skor/ / gnyan se gnyis ka'i gtad rgya yongs rdzogs zhus/ /de yang bdag don gzhan don gnyis ka dang*/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i bar chad srung byed pa/ /bka' srung bstan srung chos srung lus srung dang*/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtad rgya rnam pa drug /de gzhan gang zag re re'i gtad rgya dang*/ /thun mong ma yin pa yi gtad rgya rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis thob pa yin/ /de las gzhan yang mnyam grol gdams pa'i skor/ /gzhung dems brgal len brda' dang kha 'thor sogs/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis rdzogs par thob/ /'jam dpal me ri gsang ba'i rgyud las ni/ /gsungs pa 'jam dpal thugs kyi sgrub pa la/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba don gyi dbang*/ /gdams par bcas pa ma lus thob pa yin/ /de las gzhan yang zhi byed so yi lugs/ /don brgyud rig pa gcer mthong zhes pa dang*/ /zhi byed kam lugs gdan bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi/ /bka' dang chos skor rnams kyang bdag gis zhus// gzhan yang kha rag sgom chung chos skor la/ /spungs pa sems byung kha 'thor rnams la ni/ /kha rag skor gsum zhes byar grags pa'ang zhus/ /bde mchog grub thob paṇa chen ngag dbang gis/ /lo tsā mar pa dol pa las brgyud pa'i/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /de yi bsnyen sgrub rnams dang chos skor la/ /rtsa rgyud kun spyod a bi dha na dang*/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ni he ru ka/ /mngon 'byung de bzhin phag mo mngon 'byung rgyud/ /sgrub thabs lo hi pa dang dkyil chog ni/ /la ba pa yi dbang bzhi snyan brgyud bcas/

/gzhan yang nag po pa yi chos drug dang*/ /ra tri ra yi chos gsum rnams dang ni/ /sgrub thabs phran bu bdun cu rtsa gnyis thos/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /ga ya dha ra las brgyud ma rgyud kyi/ /nyams len mthar thug ka ra na zhes pa'i/ /bstan bcos rtsa 'grel bcas pa bdag gis thos/ /gsang chen mchog gi nges pa'i man ngag dang*/ /bde ba mthar phyin byed pa'i man ngag kyang*/ /ga ya dha ra'i nyams len mthar thug rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis thob pa yin// gzhan yang sgrol ba'i mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /nag po spyi yi dbang du grags pa yi/ /yi dwags phal cher dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /lung gi ṭīka'i tshul du dbang bskur dang*/ /de yi chos skor rtsa ba 'grel par bcas/ /lag tu blang rgyu phyag bzhes mdo byang gi / mchan bu de yi sgom 'grel la sogs pa/ /ṭīka bzhi dang bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po yis/ /dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud la ni/ /brten nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yi/ /sgrub thabs gnas yig spog chog zhal gdams dang*/ /phrin las bzhi yi rjes gnang bcas pa thob/ /mi bdag 'khor lo las tshogs drug cu brgyad/ /zhal gyi gdams par bcas pa rnams kyang zhus/ /ma tis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po yi/ /rjes gnang sgrub thabs mi g.yo pus btsugs kyi/ /sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa bdag gis zhus/ /bla ma mkhan chen shes rab rin chen la/ /slob dpon chen po a bha ka ra'i lugs/ /lo chen chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur steng nas/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa yi/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i bka' rnams rdzogs par zhus/ /de yi chos skor phreng ba skor gsum dang*/ /chos spyod byang chub gzhung lam rnams kyang thos/ /gzhan yang snang sing zhang lo nas brgyud pa'i/ /dbang gi chu bo yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /snye ma skor lnga ma lus rdzogs par thob/

/slob dpon chen po bhi ma pa yis ni/ /bram ze nag po pa las brgyud pa yi/ /'chi med grub pa dbang bzhi'i khrid ka dang*/ /gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis rdzogs par zhus/ /tshe dpag med pa dkar po'i byin rlabs ni/ /sgrub bka' gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /khyad par rdo rje phreng ba'i rdzogs rim ni/ /man ngag snye chung zhes byar grags pa yi/ /bklag lung zhang nga kun rin drung du zhus// mnga' ris nas byon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi/ /drung du dbang dang gdams ngag zhus pa la/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ra lugs dbang ka dang*/ /de yi chos skor rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud// sgrub thabs ye shes seng ges mdzad pa dang*/ /slo dpon shrī bha dras mdzad pa yi/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa ni bdag gis thob/ /tstshun da ra yi cho ga zhib mo dang*/ /de yi rnam bshad rdo rje grags kyis mdzad/ /ye shes grags kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang*/ /de bzhin rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa yi/ /rgyud kyi ti ka zhal shes bcas pa dang*/ /man ngag gnas bdun bla ma mnga' ris pa/ /nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rnams kyang thob/ / gshed dmar bcu gsum pa yi bdag 'jug dang*/ /gtor chog mngon rtogs bram ze dpal 'bum gyis/ /mdzad pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg gnyis/ /lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa maṇḍal gyi/ /cho ga rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /lha lnga lhan skyes lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga smin byed dbang gi sgron ma dang*/ /tshogs 'khor lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'phags pas mdzad pa rnams kyang thos pa yin/ /de gzhan bla ma lnga bcu pa yang thos//

chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs pad la/ /gtugs nas bka' lung man ngag zhus pa la/ /chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /skyes rabs bsdebs pa thog mar thos pa yin/ /de rjes rdzogs pa chen po snying thig gi/ dbang bzhi khrid bka' zab pod bzhi dang ni/ /snying thig bka' ma'i skor yang bdag la gnang*/ /a pa dhū ti pa la bskur tshul gyi/ / dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gis bdag smin byas/ /sgrub thabs dkyil chog gdams skor rnams dang ni/ /nang don rtsa 'grel dam tshig rtsa 'grel dang*/ /gzhan yang rtsis kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa/ /drung gis brtsams chos phran tshegs phal cher thos/ /gegs sel bka' rgya ma la sogs pa'o/ /u rgyan pa yi rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub kyang*/ /phyag len zhal gyi gdams par bcas pa gnang*/ /dus 'khor rgyud 'grel bcas pa'i bshad ka dang*/ / mtshan brjod 'grel pa padma dkar po thos/ /chos skyong mgon po ber nag can dang ni/ /lha mor bcas pa'i sgrub thabs bdag la gnang*/ /chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dgyes rdor gyi/ /ti ka'i steng nas bshad pa rgyas pa dang*/ /sgrub thabs dkyil chog gtor chog bcas pa thob// gzhan yang bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud/ /de'i 'grel pa padma can dang ni/ / sgrub thabs dkyil chog phran skor la sogs dang*/ /bcas pa ma lus bdag gis thos pa yin/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud dang ni/ /de yi 'grel pa gru gzings sgrub dkyil sogs/ /phran skor rnams dang bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang gsang ba 'dus pa mar lugs rgyud/ /de'i 'grel pa mtha' drug chen mo dang*/ /gzhan yang sgrub dkyil la sogs phran skor rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ do ha skor gsum thun 'jog sham bu can/ /mtha' bzhi chos 'khor chos drug sham bu can/ /phyag na rdo rje khyung gi sham bu can/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rig 'dzin sham bu can/ /de la sogs pa sku gsum ngo sprod khrid/

/de dag thams cad bdag la gnang ba yin// gzhan yang karma pakshis mdzad pa yi/ /gdams ngag rgya mtsho mtha' yas de bzhin du/ / zab rgyas rgya mtsho mtha' yas zab chos skor/ /'khor lo lnga ma la sogs kun kyang gnang*/ / gzer lnga dang ni gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ /de las gzhan pa rlung lnga gegs sel dang*/ / rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig rnams kyang gnang*/ /sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs sogs/ /chos skor rnams kyang bdag la gnang ba yin/ /gzhan yang dus gsum mkhyen pas mdzad pa yi/ /rmi lam 'brel pa gsum ldan ma yang gnang*/ /gtum mo la bar ma dang bla ma yi/ /gtum mo dang ni gtum mo 'jug thabs gsum/ /gtum mo gangs kyi seng chen ma dang ni/ /mchog gi gtum mo rnams kyang bdag la gnang*/ /nad 'don gsum pa gegs sel thor bu rnams/ /rje btsun ma yi sgrub thabs bcas pa gnang*/ /nā ro chos drug ro snyoms sgang dril dang*/ /shrī sing ha'i dmar khrid rnams kyang thob/ /gru yi lugs kyi rtag pa tshan 'dzin bcas/ /gzhan yang rin chen snying sgron rgyud kyi skor/ /don skor lnga pa zhes su grags pa yi/ /tsi tsi dzwa la'i nad las thar byed pa'i/ /gdams pa khyad 'phags rnams kyang bdag la gnang*/ /gzhan yang 'chi med 'bring por grags pa yi/ /la stod mgon po las brgyud 'khrul 'khor ni/ /sum cu so gnyis pa yang bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang a ma lab kyi sgron ma yi/ /gcod yul bka' brgyud rin chen 'phreng ba'ang thos// de gzhan rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med kyi/ /gdams skor pad ma 'byung gnas yab yum lugs/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig zhes su grags pa yi/ /dbang dang ngo sprod gdams skor ma lus dang*/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po khro 'dus kyi/ /rgyud dang gdams par bcas pa ma lus thob/ /mon mo tsug rum nas byung rnams kyang thos/ /de rnams kun gyi chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ /rang rang so so'i dkar chag nang na gsal/

/'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo lnga bcu/ /drung nas mdzad pa'i bsdus don bcas pa'ang thob/ /de yi mdo grangs lnga bcu tham pa ni/ /dkar chag nang na gsal bas 'dir ma bris/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ /sbyor ba gsum gyi snying po'i khrid kyang thob/ /bcud len gyi ni be bum chen mo dang*/ /drung gis mdzad pa'i gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ /la sogs gdams phran khyad 'phags du ma dang*/ /gzhan yang byams pa'i chos lnga rnams kyang thos/ /mched grogs gong ma rtogs ldan ye rgyal la/ /rdzogs pa chen po yang gsang bla med kyi/ /bcu bdun rgyud kyi bklag lung rdzogs par zhus// de gzhan slob dpon 'dan ma blo bzang las/ /slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs dang*/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyang thos pa yin/ /gdams ngag rgya mtsho la sogs gdams phran 'ga'/ /thos shing gzhan yang he ru ka la yang*/ /ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad bstan bcos ni/ /mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa'ang thos pa yin// gzhan yang bla ma gzhon nu rgyal po las/ /rdzogs chen gsang skor dbang gi ngo sprod dang*/ /rgya mtsho ar gtad bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /sangs rgyas rang chas bstan pa bu gcig dang*/ /snying gi dgongs pa thugs kyi me long dang*/ /bshad rgyud thig le kun gsal bcas pa thob/ /ba lam bla ma rin chen shes rab la/ /grub thob chen po mi tra dzo gi nas/ / brgyud pa'i dbang bka' brgya dang rtsa brgyad zhus/ /de yi chos skor phreng ba skor lnga ni/ / dkyil chog cho ga rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ /de bzhin mngon rtogs mu tig phreng ba dang*/ /sbyin sreg 'od phreng rkang grangs rin chen phreng*/ /dpe bris dkyil 'khor phreng ba rnams dang ni/ / de dag rdzogs rim sems nyid ngal gso ba'i/ /gdams pa rtsa ba 'grel ba bcas pa thob/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi cho ga'i rnam grangs ni/ /rkang grangs rin chen phreng ba'i nang na gsal//

bla ma kun mkhyen kun dga' don grub kyi/ /drung du bka' lung man ngag zhus pa la/ /dus kyis 'khor lo'i dbang bka' 'grel pa dang*/ /rjes su mthun par shin tu rgyas par zhus/ /u rgyan pa yi zhal gzigs tshogs bdag gi /rjes gnang yang ni zhor la zhus pa yin/ /rgyud kyi bshad pa chos rje snye mdo bas/ /mdzad pa'i ti ka'i steng na thob pa yin/ / 'grel pa dri med 'od la bklag lung mdzad/ /sbyor drug khrid lung dang ni rtsa rgyud las/ / bkol pa dum bu'i rgyud ni dbang mdor bstan/ /de gzhan bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung rgyud/ /mkha' 'gro glu gar tshogs mchod rol pa bzhi/ /dum bu rgyud du grags pa bzhi po dang*/ /dus 'khor bstod pa rgyun chags rnams kyang thos/ /gzhan yang she'u lo tsās bsgyur ba yi/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs zhus/ /chos rje rang byung rdo rje las brgyud pa'i/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang rdzogs zhus/ /gzhan yang gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor dbang*/ /rim lnga'i khrid dang bcas pa bdag gis zhus/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dgra nag gdong drug gi /dbang rgyud gdams skor la sogs bcas pa rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /de bzhin gshin rje gshed dmar rgyud dang ni/ /gshed dmar lhan skyes chos skor rnams kyang zhus/ /bde mchog bcu gsum ma yi dbang bka' dang*/ /gdams skor ma lus pa yang bdag gis thob/ /gshed dmar bcu gsum ma dang lha lnga yi/ /dbang dang gdams skor thams cad rdzogs par zhus/ / gsang 'dus bshad rgyud gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi/ /dbang bka' gsang chen rigs bsdus chen po ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nyid la zhus/ /rgyud kyi lung ni slob dpon mgon po dpal/ /lung mang po zhes grags pa de la zhus/ /lo tsā grags pa rgyal mtshan las brgyud pa/ /mi g.yo bla med dbang bskur rgyud bcas thob// gzhan yang ngan song sbyong rgyud bshad bka' dang*/

/'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug dang ni/ /de bzhin 'jig rten pa yi dkyil 'khor drug /de ltar dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dbang bka' thob/ /de gzhan zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma yi/ /dbang bka' lam lnga lam gsum thun mong dang*/ /bde gshegs bcu gnyis bdud rtsi bum chung dang*/ /rten 'brel khang 'jug chos skyong a gho ra/ /yon bdag a rtsi'i rjes gnang bcas pa zhus/ /de dag chos skor mdo rgyud lag len bcas/ /de bzhin bka' bab snyan brgyud bcas pa dang*/ /dri med phra thig zhib mo dar tshag bcas/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /de las gzhan yang chos rje rgod tshang pa'i/ /bla ma mos gus rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi/ /byin rlabs thun mong ma yin pa yang zhus/ /mar pa lo tsā'i khyad chos shog dril bzhi/ / phyag rgya chen po bar do blo gcod dang*/ /rtsa rlung dra mig 'pho ba spyi brdol ma/ /de dag rnams kyang phyag len bcas pa zhus// de las gzhan yang rje btsun ras chung lugs/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu gsum du grags/ /yab bka' yum bka' ma lus rdzogs par zhus/ /gzhan yang rdo rje phur pa lha nag ma'i/ /zhal mthong brgyud pa ma chad pa yi dbang*/ /bka' lung gdams par bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /so nas brgyud pa'i yang dag me gcig ma/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma chad pa yi bka'/ /lag len bcas pa dang ni tshe sgrub kyi/ /sgrub ka rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa mdo yi dbang bka' la/ /phyi dbang rgyud kyi chu bo bcu la ni/ / nang tshegs phye na brgya dang rtsa brgyad yong*/ /nang dbang 'dus pa'i chu bo bcu gcig la/ / nang tshegs phye na drug brgya dang yang drug /sgrub dbang grags pa'i chu bo bcu bzhi la/ /nang tshegs phye na brgya dang bco lnga yod/ /gsang dbang rdzogs pa'i chu bo gnyis po la/ /nang tshegs med phyir de ltar kun dril bas/ /'dus pa chen po mdo yi dbang la ni/

/dbang gi rnam grangs brgyad brgya so gcig yod/ /de dag ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par zhus// bla ma rtogs ldan don grub ye shes la/ /bde ba shānti pa zhes grags pa yi/ /rol pa'i khro bo snyem pa'i dbang bzhi zhus/ /de yi chos skor chos sna bco brgyad yod/ /gzhan yang bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs de yi chos skor ni/ /seng gdong mkha' 'gros sing ha kīrti la/ /gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhi dang ni/ /de yi gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa/ /skye med zhang gi rnam thar bka' rgya ma/ /bzhi yi nang nas lha sa ma yi dbang*/ /rnam thar zhal gdams la sogs gdams skor bcas/ /ma mo chen mo'i sgom gyi khrid lung dang*/ /phyag len bcas pa'ang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /gzhan yang gu ru chos dbang las brgyud pa'i/ /padma bcud bsdus dbang gi chu bo bzhi/ /yongs su rdzogs pa de yi gdams skor bcas/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis rdzogs par thob// paṇa chen bu ston rin chen grub la yang*/ /dus 'khor shong 'gyur steng nas mkhan chen ba'i/ /yig cha btab pa'i steng nas tshar gcig thob/ /sgra yi bstan bcos mtshams sbyor lnga pa bslab/ /mtshan brjod 'grel pa nyi ma dpal yas kyis/ /mdzad pa de dang 'grel chung padma can/ /rtsa rgyud dum bu bzhi yi dang po thos/ /sā dhu pu tra'i sgrub thabs chen mo dang*/ / yan lag bzhi pa ra lugs pa yang thob/ /mdor bsdus dang po'i 'grel pa paṇḍi ta/ /mi g.yo snying pos mdzad pa de yang thos/ /man lung gu rus mdzad pa'i sbyor drug dang*/ /rim lnga'i khrid dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho thos/ /bla ma 'brom ston seng ge rgyal mtshan la/ /gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa rgyud phyi mar bcas/ /khyad par de dag rnams kyi bshad pa'i rgyud/ /rdo rje phreng ba dgongs pa lung bstan dang*/ /lha mo bzhis zhus ye shes kun las btus/

/rtsa rgyud 'grel pa sgron gsal zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'ang thos/ /de las gzhan yang gsang 'dus phreng skor la/ /klu sgrub snying pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ / mdor byas mdor bsres dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*/ /nyi shu pa dang tshogs 'khor rim pa dang*/ /sems 'grel che chung byang sems rnam bshad dang*/ /sgrub thabs rnam gzhag rim pa rdzogs rim ni/ /rim lnga'i khrid lung rnams kyang bdag gis thob/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog de las gzhan/ /ārya de ba'i spyod bsdus sgron ma dang*/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang sems kyi sgrib sbyong dang*/ /bdag byin rlabs dang mngon par byang chub rim/ /'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i snying po rgyan/ /'phags pas mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg cho gar bcas/ /de dag ma lus bdag gis thos pa yin// gzhan yang gsang 'dus lus dkyil dbang bka' thob/ /gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs dbang gi bka'/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rig gtad bcas/ /khro bo bcu yi bzlas lung rnams kyang thob/ /gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs su grags pa/ /bcu gsum ma yi dbang dang sgrub thabs dang*/ /gtor ma'i cho gar bcas pa bdag gis thob/ / gzhan yang gsang 'dus gnyos lugs dbang bka' dang*/ /'bri mtshams zhang lo shes rab bla ma las/ /brgyud pa'i dbang bka' phyag len bcas pa ni/ /gcen lugs gcung lugs gnyis ka bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang dgra nag zhang lugs dbang bka' ni/ /drag po'i rjes gnang gdams skor bcas pa thob/ /de yi chos skor rtsa rgyud le'u ni/ /bco brgyad pa dang 'grel pa shānti pas/ /mdzad pa rin chen sgron me yang ni thos/ /dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad 'grel pa lhan skyes grub/ /la li tas mdzad dkyil chog rin chen 'byung*/ /de yi mchod rten bca' ba'i cho ga dang*/ /mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /ku mud kha phye srung 'khor chig chod ni/

/nyi shu pa dang sbas gcod rnam par 'phel/ /slob dpon klu yi byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i/ /gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs snyan chung ma/ /yi dwags rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo dang*/ /zhang los mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim rim bzhi la/ /rab gnas zhi rgyas drag po'i sbyin sreg gsum/ /rdo rje rtse mo lha rje dar ma yis/ /mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor lag len rnams kyang shes/ /sgrub dkyil la sogs 'dzims pa rin shes mdzad/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis mthong zhing thos// gzhan yang 'jigs byed skyo ston lo tsā'i lugs/ /dbang bka' drag po'i rjes gnang bcas pa zhus/ /de yi chos skor skyo los mdzad pa yi/ /drag po'i las bdun zhi ba'i las bdun dang*/ /'dzims pa rin shes bla ma 'phags pa yis/ /mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil la sogs rnams kyang thos/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed ba ri lugs kyi dbang*/ /gdams skor bcas pa rnams kyang bdag gis thob/ /'jigs byed ra lugs sa skya pa las ni/ /brgyud pa'i dbang yang bdag gis thos pa yin/ /'jigs byed ra lugs phyag mtshan sum cu bzhi/ /de yi las tshogs kyang ni sum cu bzhi/ /de dag rnams kyi sngags kyi rjes gnang thob/ /khro bo reg tshig lha dgu'i dbang bka' dang*/ /yab yum sgrub thabs dbang chog gtor chog dang*/ /sbyin sreg la sogs chos skor ma lus thob/ /sangs rgyas thod pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbang*/ /rgyud kyi lung dang bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang dgyes pa rdo rje sa lugs skor/ /rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis le'u nyi shu gsum/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje gur dang sambu

ṭi/ /phyi ma'i rgyud dang bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /dbang bskur rgyas pa aṣta'i bzlas lung sogs/ /gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis thob pa yin/ /slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje las brgyud pa'i/ /dges rdor nas gling ma yi dbang yang thob// rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i bstod 'grel dang*/ /shānti pas mdzad 'grel pa mu tig phreng*/ /nā ro pas mdzad nā ro 'grel chen dang*/ /skabs 'grel brgyad dang gzhan yang ka yas ta/ /bgres pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'ang bdag gis thos/ /bha ba lhas mdzad rnam par 'grel pa dang*/ /mi thub zlas mdzad ku mu da yang thos/ /dges rdor lus kyi dkyil 'khor dbang bka' dang*/ /de bzhin dgyes rdor nag po pa yi lugs/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las ni/ /gsungs pa'i dbang bka' sa lugs rngog lugs gnyis/ /de bzhin bdag med ma yi byin rlabs kyang*/ /sa rngog gnyis ka'i lugs kyang thob pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyang thos/ /bde mchog nag po pa dang lo hi pa/ /gnyis ka'i lugs kyi dbang yang bdag gis thob// sa skya lugs kyi dril bu pa yi dbang*/ /rim lnga'i byin rlabs khrid lung dang bcas thob/ /de bzhin lha lnga dril bu pa yi dbang*/ /dril bu pas mdzad sgrub thabs bcas pa thob/ /bde mchog bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi/ /rgyud dang dbang bka' bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /a bhi dha na he ru sngon 'byung dang*/ /mkha' 'gro kun spyod de las gzhan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor rgyud kyang thob/ /phag mo mngon 'byung rgyud dang dbang bka' ni/ /sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa rnams kyang thos/ /bde mchog jo bo lugs su grags pa yi/ /bcu gsum ma yi dbang bka' sgrub dkyil bcas/ /lo hi pa yi bde mchog bcu gsum ma/ /de yi dbang bka' yang ni thob pa yin/ /bde mchog lhan skyes dril bu pa yi lugs/ /byin rlabs bka' dang sgrub thabs bcas pa thob/

/gzhan yang bde mchog rdo rje dril bu pa/ /kha che paṇa chen lugs kyang thob pa yin/ /bde mchog sdom 'byung gi ni dbang bka' dang*/ /rgyud 'grel man ngag bcas pa rnams kyang thob// rdo rje ā ralli dang ri gi ā ra lis/ /rnyog ma med pa'i rgyud dang ra lli nyi shu bzhi/ /de ltar bde mchog ra li'i rgyud sde ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun rnams kyang bklags lung thob/ /de gzhan phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud/ /ye shes snying po'i rgyud dang de bzhin du/ /ye shes thig le'i rgyud dang de kho na/ /nyid du nges pa sgron ma'i rgyud dang ni /gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud kyi bklags lung thob/ /nā ro mkha' spyod me trī mkha' spyod dang*/ /gnyis ka lha re ma yi byin rlabs thob/ /gzhan yang phag mo gzhung drug byin rlabs kyi/ /bka' dang gdams skor rnams kyang thos pa yin/ /me tri lugs kyi gdam chog bcu gsum ma'i/ /dbang bka' gzhan yang grub rnying nas byung ba'i/ /bcu gsum ma yi dbang yang bdag gis thos/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rgyud kyi dbang ka ni/ /zhi khro gnyis dang de yi chos skor la/ /ku ku rā tsa'i gsang don bkod pa drug /bde ba spyod pas mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil bcas/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis thob pa yin/ /brtag pa bcu pa sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rgyud/ /de yi phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma dang*/ /zla gsang thig le rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi rgyud kyang thos// ma hā mā yā'i dbang bka' rgyud dang ni/ /nag po pas mdzad 'grel pa dran pa ma/ /shānti pas mdzad 'grel pa yon tan ldan/ /ku ku ri pa'i sgrub thabs chung ba dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa/ /gzhung chung drug dang blo bzang snying po yi/ /rdzogs rim de nyid nges pa la sogs pa/ /phran bur bcas pa rnams kyang thob pa yin/ /phag mo shes rab snang ba'i byin rlabs bka'/ /kaṅkā sbyin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/

/bstod par bcas pa'ang bdag gis thob cing thos// rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa rgyud chen po ni/ /rab byed bcu drug pa dang bshad pa'i rgyud/ / mant+ra aṃ sha yang dag bsdus sbyor dang*/ /snying po mdor bsdus la sogs chos skor rnams/ / dbang dang gdams par bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /rnal 'byor dbang bskur ba yang bdag gis thob/ /sgrol ma mngon 'byung rgyud nas gsungs pa yi/ /lha tshogs bcu bdun dbang dang gdams skor bcas/ /gzhan yang sgrol ma lus dkyil dbang yang thob/ /rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brangs pa yi/ /sgrol ma bcu gcig ma yi dbang dang ni/ /au ḍī ya na nyer lnga ma yi dbang*/ /pa ra hi ta'i lam skor rnams dang bcas/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /mchog gi sgrol ma ral gcig ma yi dbang*/ /yum rkyang gi ni byin rlabs bcas pa thob// gzhan yang spyod pa'i rgyud la gtogs pa yi/ /las kyi kha tshar sna tshogs 'byung ba'i dbang*/ gdams skor bcas pa rnams kyang bdag gis thob/ /mi g.yo bla med zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /lha dgu'i dbang dang rig byed nyi shu lnga/ /blo chen gyis mdzad sgrub dkyil steng nas thob/ /bde chen ral gcig rgyud dang dbang bka' bcas/ /gzhan yang rta mgrin nag po'i byin rlabs bka'/ /sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa'ang thob pa yin/ /tshe dpag med pa rnal 'byor bla med lugs/ /ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub dkyil sogs/ /dbang dang gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /tshe dpag med pa'i mdo dang gzhan yang ni/ /'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs dang dze tā ris/ /mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog bstod pa dang*/ /'chi bslur bcas pa lha dgu'i dbang bka' thob// phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang mar grags pa/ /rdo rje sa 'og le'u bcu gsum ma/ /rgyud dang dbang bkar bcas pa'ang bdag gis thob/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po phyag drug pa/ /gsang ba bstan pa le'u bcu gsum dang*/ /bcu bdun ma gnyis dbang dang gdams skor ni/

/ slob dpon zhing gi rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ /sgrub thabs la sogs ma lus bdag gis thos/ / phyag na rdo rje ba ri lugs grags pa/ /slob dpon stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i/ /sgrub thabs lha dgu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /dkyil chog dbang bkar bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /phyag na rdo rje bha ba mar grags pa/ /bha ba lhas mdzad sgrub dkyil steng nas thob/ /gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes las brgyud pa/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po rnying 'gyur gyi/ /dbang dang gdams skor rnams kyang thob pa yin// gzhan yang snyan chung lo tsā las brgyud pa'i/ /tshe bdag gsar ma'i dbang yang bdag gis thob/ /rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug rtogs pa dang*/ /de yi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa'ang thob/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang bzlas lung bcas/ /sgrub thabs gnyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis po/ /thams cad bdag gis thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ / dkar chag nang na gsal bas 'dir ma bkod// gzhan yang gsang sngags phyi lugs rnal 'byor gyi/ /rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa dum bu bzhi/ /phyi ma'i rgyud bcas slob dpon kun snying gis/ /mdzad pa'i 'grel pa de nyid snang ba'ang thob/ /dum bu dang po rdo rje dbyings dang ni/ /dum bu gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi/ /dbang bskur thob cing gzhan la'ang 'grel pa yi/ /rjes 'brang rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bzhi'i/ /dbang bskur yang ni bdag gis thob pa yin/ /sgrub thabs sems dang 'byung chung yang ni thos/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi/ /dbang bskur thob cing rgyud kyang thob pa yin/ /cha mthun dpal mchog rgyud kyi dum bu bzhi/ /dum bu dang po dpal mchog sher dum dang*/ /dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang dang ni/ /rigs bsdus chen po'i dbang yang bdag gis thob/ /rgyud dang 'grel pa bcas pa bdag gis thob// 'jam dpal gsang ldan dbang dang gdams pa'i skor/

/sgrub thabs gsang ldan la sogs phran skor drug /slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ gsang 'dus 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs sogs/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis thos pa yin/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa yi/ /'grel chen rjes su 'brangs pa'i dkyil chog dang*/ /nam mkha' dri med chen po'i dbang yang thob/ /nam mkha' dri med chung bar grags pa'i dbang*/ /sgrub thabs la sogs rgya gzhung bcu bdun dang*/ /dbang dang gdams par bcas pa ma lus thos/ /gzhan yang mtshan brjod spyod rgyud du bkral ba/ /a ra pa tsa na yi dbang bskur dang*/ /rigs gsum spyi yi rig gtad cho ga dang*/ /rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub rgyud/ /phyi ma'i rgyud bcas dbang bkar bcas pa'ang thob/ /kri ya dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud dang ni/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba yi rgyud/ /mi g.yo pa yi gsang rgyud chen po dang*/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud kyang bdag gis thob/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub rjes gnang thob/ /yo ga spyi rgyud thams cad gsang ba dang*/ /yo ga rab gnas rgyud kyang bdag gis thob/ /dam tshig gsum bkod rgyud kyi dum bu gsum/ / rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ / rtogs pa dang ni gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ /rig pa mchog dang legs par grub pa dang*/ / gsang ba spyi rgyud rnams kyang bdag gis thob// bsam gtan rim par phye ba phyi ma'i rgyud/ /gzhan yang rnam snang mngon par byang chub rgyud/ /gsang ba bstan chung rdo rje sa 'og rgyud/ /ku ru kulle rtogs pa lnga pa'i rgyud/ /mgon po mngon 'byung rgyud dang de las gzhan/ /phur pa rtsa dum rnams kyang bdag gis thob/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms snur lugs dbang bka' dang*/ /gzungs dang sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa yi/ /sgrub dkyil bya bsrung cho ga rnams kyang thob/ /gtsug tor dri med dang ni rnam rgyal gyi/

/rjes gnang rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /gdugs dkar bcu bdun ma dang mi 'khrugs pa/ /rnga lugs dang ni jo bo lugs gnyis kyi/ /dbang dang sgrub dkyil khrus chog bdun tshigs sogs/ /chos skor rnams kyang bdag gis rdzogs par zhus// kha che ye shes rdo rje las brgyud pa'i/ /sa lugs su grags mi 'khrugs pa yi dbang*/ / bkras lung nam bsod kyis mdzad dkyil mchog gi /steng nas bdag gis rdzogs par zhus pa yin/ /'jam dpal dkar po dang ni rnon po yi/ /rjes gnang gnyis dang dbyangs can dkar mo yi/ /rjes gnang rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /gur mgon lha lnga'i dbang dang rjes gnang dang*/ /chos skyong mgon po gdong bzhi phyag bzhi pa'i/ /rjes gnang gtor lung bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang chos skyong gdong bzhi phyag drug pa'i/ / rjes gnang sgrub thabs bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /mgon po gri gug ma yang bdag gis thob/ /ra ma ṭi'i sgrub thabs dmags zor ni/ /bstod pa rgyal po'i rgyud dang bcas pa dang*/ /re ṭi srog tig rnams kyang bdag gis thob/ /rnam sras rjes gnang gdams skor bcas pa dang*/ /gzhan yang rin chen gter gyi rgyud dang ni/ /gnod sbyin gar mkhan mchog gi rtogs pa dang*/ /yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i rgyud kyang thos// gzhan yang slob dpon dngos grub rdo rje la/ /'dul ba lung gi bklag lung rdzogs par zhus/ /de las gzhi dang rnam 'byed phran tshegs dang*/ /gzhung dang bzhi las gzhi la bam po ni/ /brgya dang dgu ste rnam 'byed gnyis la'ang*/ /brgya dang bcu gcig phran tshegs drug cu dang*/ /gzhung la drug cu re bzhi kun dril bas/ /bam po sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi dang*/ / shlo ka 'bum nyis stong nyis brgya rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /de las gzhan yang slob dpon gang ser ba/ /bsod nams grags la 'khrul 'khor rgyas sdebs kyi/

/rgyud kyi lde mig ti ka byang nag dang*/ /sngags lnga 'khrul 'khor gzhan yang 'bro lo yi/ /rlung 'khor nag po'i rgyud dang gdams skor rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /bla ma bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims la/ /rwa 'bro gnyis ka las brgyud dus 'khor gyi/ /dbang dang gdams skor bcas pa rnams dang ni/ /u rgyan pa la byang chen bsod 'phel gyis/ /zhus pa'i tsa mi sbyor phreng rgyud snying dang*/ /dbang gi rab phyed sbyor phreng bcas pa thob// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi phyi ma dang*/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi don dam bsnyen pa dang*/ /bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung rgyud kyang thos/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum dang*/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud dang ni/ /jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i dges rdor gyi/ /yab bka' yum bka' dbang gi chu bo thob/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i 'grel pa ku mu ti/ / 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba padma can/ /rje btsun ma ni shes rab gsal byed dang*/ / de yi 'grel par bcas pa rnams kyang thob/ /jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog ni/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis pa yi dbang bka' dang*/ /bde mchog bcu gsum ma yi dbang yang thob/ / dpal ldan rga lo'i bde mchog lhan skyes kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang yang bdag gis thob/ /bde mchog 'khor lo dpa' bo drug dang ni/ /dpa' mo drug gi byin rlabs rnams kyang thob/ /gzhan yang phag mo gzhung drug byin rlabs ni/ /gdams skor rnams dang bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /phag mo ser mo thugs sgrub byin rlabs dang*/ /phag mo nag mo khros nag byin rlabs kyi/ /bka' dang gdams skor ma lus rdzogs par thob/ /gzhan yang rje btsun bzhugs gdan ma can gyi/ /byin rlabs bka' dang gdams skor thams cad thob/ / phag mo mngon 'byung rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /phag mo nag mo bcu gsum ma yi dbang*/ / sgrub thabs bcas pa bdag gis thob pa yin/

/me tri pa yi phag nag gsang sgrub dang*/ / de'i chos skor rnams kyang bdag gis zhus/ /glan sgom ras pa'i rdo rje'i gseb lam ma/ / dbang dang gdams ngag phyag len bcas pa thob// dur khrod bdag po le'u brgyad pa'i rgyud/ /phrin las sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa yi/ /chos skor rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /rngog pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje gdan bzhi yi/ /yab bka' yum bka' chos skyong dud sol ma'i/ /rjes gnang gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis zhus/ /gsang ba 'dus pa lus dkyil dbang bka' dang/ /gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gtsor byas pa'i/ /bcu gsum ma yi dbang yang bdag gis zhus/ /gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi/ /bcu dgu ma yi dbang dang de bzhin du/ /gshin rje gshed dmar bcu gsum ma yi dbang*/ /de bzhin gshin rje gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang*/ / de yi rdzogs rim shin tu spros med dang*/ /'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa de las gzhan/ / spros med kho na nyid kyi man ngag dang*/ /de bzhin 'tsho ba'i man ngag de kho na/ /nyid du nges pa'i gdams skor rnams kyang thob/ /thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ /dbang dang gdams skor rnams kyang bdag gis thob/ /'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po ni/ / snyan chung lo tsas bsgyur ba'i dbang yang thob/ /dha na ta la las brgyud phyi 'gyur gyi/ /tshe bdag dbang bka' yang ni bdag gis thob/ /gshin rje gshed po 'joms byed 'bar ba yi/ /sngags kyi bzlas lung bcas pa bdag gis thob/ /rdo rje bde khros rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dbang dang ni/ /gdams skor bcas pa ma lus bdag gis thob//

spyir gyi phur pa lugs kyi phung po yang*/ /skor du bsdus na rtsa ba'i skor dang ni/ /mdo skor rgyud skor gsang skor bzhi ru 'dus/ /rtsa ba bi to ta ma la zhes pa/ /'bum sde bkod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bka' ni/ /slob dpon padma'i dkyil chog steng nas thob/ /de gzhan phur pa kyi dang gro yi lugs/ /sgrub bka' las bzhi 'phyang brgyad gdams skor bcas/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam po las brgyud pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba yi/ /dbang dang gdams skor ma lus bdag gis zhus// gzhan yang bya khyung las rgyud chen po dang*/ /khyung gi rgyud chen bya khyung glog 'gyu'i rgyud// de dag rnams kyi bklag lung thob pa yin/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud dang ni/ / 'grel pa'i bklags lung yang ni thob pa yin/ /tshogs bdag sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa dang*/ /ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dzambha la/ /yab yum bcas pa'i sgrub thabs bdag gis thob/ /gzhan yang rnam sras zangs dkar lugs dang ni/ /phyag na rdo rje lcags sbubs mar grags pa'i/ /rig gtad gdams skor bcas pa bdag gis thob/ / phyag na rdo rje be con ma yi dbang*/ /rgyud dang sgrub thabs gdams skor bcas pa thob/ /rnam 'joms bir wa lugs kyi bka' dang ni/ /rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi rig gtad thob/ / gzungs mdo grwa lnga'i rig gtad cho ga dang*/ /de bzhin 'od zer can gyi rjes gnang dang*/ / rigs gsum spyi yi rig gtad rnams kyang thob/ /sgo drug gzungs kyi cho gar grags pa yi// gzungs 'dus spyi yi rig gtad cho ga dang*/ /gzungs mchog spyi yi rig gtad rnams kyang thob/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i rjes gnang dang*/ /ri khrod lo ma can gyi rig gtad dong*/ /sman lha'i rig gtad mdo chog bcas pa'ang thob/ /slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa yi/ /dkyil chog steng nas yum chen dbang rdzogs dang*/

/sher snying lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bcas pa thob/ /rnam snang mngon byang rgyud dang phyi mar bcas/ /yo ga thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyang thob/ /thugs rje chen po padma cod pan dang*/ /padma dra ba'i rgyud kyang bdag gis thob/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i rtog pa dang*/ /de bzhin 'od zer can ma'i rtog pa'i rgyud/ /don yod zhags pa'i rtogs pa rnams kyang thob/ /de las gzhan yang dpal mchog gshed dum dang*/ /gtsug dgu'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa yang thos/ /dpal mchog 'grel chen dang ni ko sa la'i/ /bklag lung rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin/ /ji bzhin mnyam pa nam mkha' mnyam rgyud dang*/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud dang*/ / phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma rnams kyang thob/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can grags pa/ /lha grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig dbang yang thob/ /mgon po mngon 'byung rgyud dang dbang ka sogs/ /chos skor thams cad bdag gis rdzogs par zhus/ /saṃ bhu ṭi yi 'grel chen man snye yi/ /bklag lung thos shing de bzhin rnal 'byor rgyud/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel chen de nyid snang*// grub thob brgyad cu'i rtogs brjod brgyad cu dang*/ /do ha brgyad cu bstod pa brgyad cu dang*/ /byin rlabs brgyad cu khrid bka' brgyad cu bcas/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /grub pa sde bdun de bzhin snying po'i skor/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga de dag phyogs mthun bcas/ /do ha sku gsung thugs kyi mdzod gsum dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma dang ni/ / bir wa pa yi 'chi med rnams kyang thob// dbu ma chen po'i byin rlabs khrid dang bcas/ /klu sgrub mdzad srol snar thang pa las brgyud/ /de yang bla ma bag la bdag gis thob/ /phyag rgya chen po rdar tsa sum cu pa/ /a ma na se 'bru tsho bskor rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs bka' dang gdams skor rnams kyang thob/ /de la gdams skor sum cu tham pa yod/

/rgya gar gsang spyod chung bar grags pa yi/ /rtsa ba dpal ldan sha ri dbang phyug gi /brda' rgyud rdo rje'i gur dang zhal gdams dang*/ /byin rlabs bcas pa bdag gis thob pa yin/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i ro snyoms skor drug gi / brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rnam rtog lam khyer dang*/ /nyon mongs lam khyer lha 'dre lam khyer dang*/ /na tsha lam khyer 'chi ba lam khyer dang*/ /bca' gzhi gtam brgyud la sogs chos skor rnams/ /thams cad rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /gzhan yang rgod tshang pa yi khrid chen brgyad/ /bla ma mos gus rgyu 'bras rten 'brel khrid/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor byang chub sems kyi khrid/ /gsang gcod bzlog sgom byang chub sems kyi khrid/ /zhing skyong spel sbyong nā ro chos drug gi/ /khrid ka rnams kyi khrid lung bdag gis zhus/ /de gzhan gtum mo zhag bdun ma yang zhus// mkha' 'gro ni gu ma yi chos drug gi /rgyud sde lnga yi rigs bsdus dbang bka' dang*/ / rdo rje'i tshig rkang gdams skor bcas pa la/ /chos drug spyi yi byin rlabs bka' gcig dang*/ /chos drug so so'i bka' drug 'chi med kyi/ /byin rlabs bka' rnams rgya gzhung bcas pa rnams/ /'chug med lam khyer rnam gsum byin rlabs kyi/ /bka' gsum mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis la yang*/ /byin rlabs bka' re de gzhan bdag med ma'i/ /nang khrid bka' dang thugs dam lha lnga yi/ /byin rlabs bka' lnga sme brtsegs grib sel bcas/ / de dag rnams kyang bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /chos rje yang dgon pa yi ri chos skor/ /yon tan kun 'byung bar do 'phrang sgrol dang*/ /rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad rnams dang ni/ /ri chos cha lag dgos pa kun 'byung dang*/ /lhan thabs gsung sgros spyan snga rin ldan gyis/ /yi ger bkod pa rnams kyang bdag gis zhus/ /gsang spyod rmad lam nad 'don hūm̐ chos ma/ / drag rlung gnad lnga 'dzag srung bka' rgya ma/

/'pho ba hūṃ dmar stong nyid rdo rje yi/ /tshig drug ma ste ma drug zhal gdams bcas/ /de dag rnams kyang bdag gis zhus pa yin/ /gzhan yang gu ru chos dbang chos skor gyi/ /thugs sgrub gsang 'dus bla ma yongs rdzogs dang*/ / thod phreng rtsal dang gsum gyi dbang bka' ni/ /gdams skor drug tshan brgyad dang bcas pa dang*/ /de dag rdzogs rim mnyam sbyor skor gsum ni/ /stong thun rgyud dang 'grel pa don khrid dang*/ /rtsal dbang la sogs gdams skor bco lnga po/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis zhus pa yin// gzhan yang jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa dang*/ /ba ri lo tsā'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ /khro phu pa yi thugs rje chen po yi/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bstan pa'i gru bor bcas/ /paṇa chen shāka shrī mi tra dzo ki dang*/ /kun ldan ras pa la sogs kyi zhal gdams rnams/ /phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa man ngag brgya rtsa ru/ /grags pa rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa lags/ / de dag kun gyi chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ /rang rang so so'i dkar chag nang na gsal/ /de las gzhan yang bstan bcos thob tshod la/ /byams pa'i chos lnga de bzhin sa sde lnga/ /ka ra ṇa sde brgyad dang bcas pa dang*/ /tshad ma sde bdun ka ra rigs tshogs drug /dbu ma rtsa she rang 'grel bcas pa dang*/ /thub pa dgongs rgyan brgyad stong 'grel chen ni/ /gnad kyi zla zer zhes su grags pa'ang thob/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo/ / sras yum bcu bdun dang ni myang 'das ni/ /kong nag ral gri las brgyud cod pan dang*/ / rtsod med brgyud pa so sor 'ded pa la/ /rgya gar rgya nag gnyis nas brgyud pa yi/ /mdo phran sil bu rnams ni mang du thos/ /de las gzhan yang mdo sde khol bu pa/ /rgyal po mdo lnga mdo sde sngon byung dang*/ /rgyan stug bkod pa gser 'od che chung dang*/ /bzang spyod mdo 'grel sa lu ljang pa sogs/ /myang 'das dang ni phal chen padma dkar/

/mdo phran sil bu rnams dang bcas pa yi/ /rnam grangs mdo mang dkar chag nang na gsal/ /gzhan yang tog gzungs dang ni gzungs 'dus dang*/ /gzungs 'bum rnams kyang bdag gis thob pa yin// gzungs rnams so so'i ming dang rnam grangs ni/ /rang rang so so'i dkar chag nang na gsal/ /'di rnams rgyu mtshan zhib par brgyud khungs bcas/ /bdag gi thob yig nang na gsal bas gzigs// mdor na thos bsam sgo nas shes bya yi/ /sgro 'dogs chod par gcod pa'i blo yod cing*/ /thod phreng rtsal dang yang dbang gter la sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar la/ /bsam nas de dag rjes su slob 'dod kyang*/ /dus kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams/ /tshad mar gyur pa'i gang zag phal cher 'das/ /bka' lung rtsod med rnams kyang phal cher nub/ /bdag kyang phal cher snyoms las dbang gyur nas/ /smos rin chog pa'i thos bsam ma 'grub mod// 'on kyang nges 'byung dad pa brtan po yis/ /thob dka' dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /'khor ba'i brtson ra 'di las ma thar cing*/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam sna ma zin na/ /dal 'byor thob kyang thob pa don re chung*/ /de snyam sems nas gzhon nu nor bzang bzhin/ /yang dag lam bsten dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal/ /rin chen gser la longs pa'i sems spangs nas/ /shes dang ngo dga' zhor gsham ma yin par/ /bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin yongs brtags nas/ /mkhas par grags pa rnams kyi thugs tshod blangs/ /man ngag mnga' bdag rnams kyi thugs mdzod brus/ /bka' lung rtsod med rnams kyang ci thob byas/ /de dag rnams kyi nang nas khyad par du/ /bstan pa'i snying po bskyed rdzogs gsum la sbyangs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab phal cher gyi/ /brjod bya rag rim blo yi yul du bab// grub thob gong ma rnams kyi bzhugs gnas su/ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen pa tshad du bskyal/ /dam can ma mgon lcam dral la sogs pa/

/dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags/ /tshe rabs snga ma'i las 'phro sad pa'i mthus/ /nges don mthar thug rdzogs chen don dang mjal/ /sems nyid ye sangs rgyas pa'i rang zhal mthong*/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du tshol ba'i rtsol ba bral/ /mthong don 'dris shing dbang 'byor thob byed thabs/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len thabs/ /bstan 'ga'i man ngag phyag len ma chad pa/ / lung thob tsam la ma ltos phu thag bcad/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs nas las sbyor tshad la phab/ / ces gsungs pa ltar dang*/ nyams len sgrub pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul yang*/ de nyid las/ de ltar thos bsam cung zad byas pa'i mthus/ /tha snyad tshig la mkhas par gyur mod kyang*/ /rang gi sems nyid gtan la ma pheb na/ /mkhas kyang don chung lung stong rjes kyis bkang*/ /de snyam sems nas snying po med pa yi/ /bya ba kun spangs ri khrod dgon pa ru/ /nang du yang dag 'jog la blo gzhol nas/ /bsam gtan 'gal rkyen mtha' dag spong ba'i thabs/ /nges med dben gnas ri khrod bas mtha' ru/ /gnas bcas ri dgas smas ma'i tshul bzung nas/ /pha yul them nang gom pa mi 'dor ba/ /yul gyi mngon zhen spangs pa'i rnam thar yin// thog ma med nas 'khor ba'i gnas 'khyams phyir/ /gnyen du ma gyur sems can gcig kyang med/ /phan gnod lan chags bda' ded yin thag bcad/ /dgra gnyen 'dam ka med pa'i rnam thar yin/ /bdag 'dzin med pa'i sa phug brag phug dang*/ /rtswa dang lo ma'i spyil por gnas bca' nas/ /ka can khang bzang bdag tu mi 'dzin pa/ /gnas la chags sems spangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /byams pas 'ching la sdang bas mi 'ching phyir/ /'dam ka byung na byams las sdang ba 'dam/ /byams rung sdang rung 'phral du lan mi 'don/ /zan gcig chang gang spangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /ji ltar skyid kyang skyid mkhan rang gi sems/ / ji bzhin sdug kyang sdug mkhan sems las med/ /sems dang sems byung 'khrul shes yin thag bcad/
