/bde sdug ro snyoms byas pa'i rnam thar yin/ /skyon la dngos dang ltar snang gnyis yod phyir/ /gzhan skyon mi rtog rtog kyang brtag dpyad med/ /rang skyon brtag shing dpyad nas tshul min spangs/ /sgo gsum bag yod byas pa'i rnam thar yin// rgyu drug skye bzhir bsdus pa'i sems can rnams/ /phung khams skye mched rang dbang gis bsdus phyir/ /gdan gsum 'dzom pa'i dkyil 'khor yin thag bcad/ /dag snang phyogs med 'byongs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /phan gnod byed pa gang zag mu bzhi yod/ /chos dang tshul min mu bzhi'ang mtshungs thag bcad/ /gang zag tshod 'dzin spangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /sems can rnam rtog mi mthun mtha' yas phyir/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /mi mkhas mkhas rlom rnams kyi ngag ma nyan/ /chos la sgro skur spangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /'dul bas gnang la mdo sdes ma bkag cing*/ /mngon pa'i don dang mthun na ma gtogs pa/ /gsang sngags sgra bzhin spyod pa'i rjes ma 'brang*/ /dam chos gzhung bzhin byas pa'i rnam thar yin/ / gzhan don rlabs chen 'grub na ma gtogs pa/ /'dag char smra bcad ri mtshams gang rung gis/ /dus 'da' mdzad spyod mi dang mi bstun pa/ /sgrub pa mtha' ru 'don pa'i rnam thar yin/ /bun bskyed dang ni gzhog slong thob 'jal spang*/ /rnyed pas rnyed pa ma btsal bas mtha' ru/ /lto gos srog 'tsho tsam la chog shes bzung*/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba spangs pa'i rnam thar yin// 'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs ma gtogs pa/ /zhing gzhis mi 'dzin sdig nor mi 'chang zhing*/ /yo byad cung zad lhag kyang yongs su gtong*/ /'dod pa tshad med spangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /'dul ba las gsungs gnang bkag dpang btsugs nas/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba/ /srog la bab la thug kyang 'dzem pa 'di/ /rgyu 'bras khyad ma bsad pa'i rnam thar yin/ /dgra 'am gnyen rnams ltos med gzhan yang rung*/

/bdag la cher brnyas gnod pa ci byas kyang*/ /ngan lan mi 'don khon du mi 'dzin pa/ /kun la zhes 'gras spangs pa'i rnam thar yin// rang nor gzhan gyis rkus sam phrog kyang rung*/ /de rjes mi gcod gnas skabs mthar thug tu/ /de la phan par 'gyur pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /sbyin gnas phyogs ris med pa'i rnam thar yin/ /gnas skabs bag dang mi ldan ltar snang yang*/ /gnang bkag rtsis na ltung bar mi 'gyur na/ /che bzhed longs spyod phyir du tshul ma 'chos/ /tshul khrims ngo lkog spangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /zag bcas mngon shes tsam yang ma thob cing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phyir du mi 'gyur na/ /rang srog gcod kyang mngon spyod las mi rtsom/ /bzod pa'i go cha gyon pa'i rnam thar yin/ /skyes mtha' 'chi nges 'chi rkyen 'tshams pa med/ /nam 'chi cha med dran pa rgyun chags kyi/ /tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom la 'bad pa 'di/ /brtson 'grus dang du blangs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /rnam rtog gang skyes mi 'gog ngos bzung nas/ / rang snang rang stong rang rig ma 'dres pa/ /rang gsal rtog med ngang la gnas pa 'di/ / bsam gtan mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnam thar yin/ /'khor 'das lam gsum rnam pa gang shar yang*/ /snang rig stong gsum ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su/ /thag chod mthar 'dzin grub mtha'i rjes ma 'brangs/ /bdag med shes rab thob pa'i rnam thar yin/ /sgra tshad snyan ngag sdeb sbyor ma sbyangs pas/ /mkhas par grags pa'i grags pa bdag la med/ /bla ma'i drin gyis go rgyu tshig gcig po/ /lus kyi las su rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ /ngag gi las su rdo rje'i bzlas pa byas/ /yid kyi las su rdo rje sems dpa' sgom/ /sgo gsum rnal du phab pa'i rnam thar yin//

mdor na bdag gis rgyun gyi nyams len bzhi/ /sdig bshags dge bsngos smon lam rgya chen btab/ /ma yengs dran pas bla ma'i zhal gdams la/ /nyams su len lugs mdor bsdus 'di ltar bgyis/ /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyis bsdus pa'i chos/ /'khor 'das lam gsum rnam pa gang shar yang*/ /rang gi sems yin sems las don gzhan med/ /sems kyi chos nyid rang gi ngo bos stongs/ /ji ltar stong yang stong mkhan rang byung yin/ /snang stong gnyis dang gnyis med gang rung du/ /rig dang rang rig yin gyi gzhan rig min/ /des na 'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /snang rig stong gsum ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su/ /thag chod yid ches rang so ma shor bar/ /gang shar bzo dang phral nas nyal ba 'di/ /g.yung ston hrul po bdag gi nyams len lags// rang don chos sku mngon du gyur tsa na/ /gzhan don gzugs sku'i phrin las shugs la 'byung*/ /nam zhig gdul bya dus la bab dus su/ /rtsol med 'gro don 'grub pa rten 'brel yin/ /des na byang chub sems kyi ljon shing 'di/ /bsrung ba'i dus dang spyad pa'i dus gnyis gsungs/ /de phyir mkha' mnyam sems can kun don du/ /tshogs gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs la 'bad dus 'dir/ /gzhan la mi phan rang la gnod pa yi/ /dam med tshogs pa bskyang du bdag mi khoms/ /gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde du ma nas/ /thog mar dpon slob 'brel brtag gces par gsungs/ /gal te ma brtag be sbrel g.yangs skyur bzhin/ /'gyur zhes gsungs pa 'di la bdag ni skrag /tshe 'di'i che thabs dang ni rnyed tshol la/ /snod skyon bzhi dang ma bral slob ma'i tshogs/ /bsdus nas dbang bskur chos bshad byas gyur kyang*/ /smin grol med phyir 'gro don ltar snang yin/ /seng zho gser snod min par blug gyur na/ /snod 'chag bcud 'bo de bzhin nges pa'i don/ /mthar thug dam chos rdzogs pa chen po 'di/ /snod min rnams la bstan du ga la rung*/

/nam bzhag gtan gyi dgos 'dod kun 'byung phyir/ /bsam 'phel don grub nor bus sgrun mi 'os/ /de 'dra'i dam chos rin chen rnyed dus 'dir/ /tshe 'di'i btsan phyug ka 'dra med kyang chog /snyigs dus sems can bsdu bzhis bsdu dka' zhing*/ /bsdus kyang thar pa'i lam la 'gro mi 'dod/ /de bas nges med dben gnas bas mtha' ru/ /sems cad kun don smon 'jug sems gnyis bskyed/ /dman pa'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gyon nas/ /sdig spangs dge spyad rang sems dmu rgod btul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas dang grub pa'i rnam thar gangs can tsam na 'gran zla med par bstan nas gya gnyis pa shing sbrul la nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas gang ba'i ltas zla sprel du snang ba dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das so// rje 'di la slob ma'i tshogs mang du yod kyang*/ gtso bor don brgyud kyi bstan pa yongs rdzogs par gtad pa ni/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje kho na'o//
